Heaven will bring me sweeter rest.
Oh, is not in grief to harm me,
While Thy love is left to me:
Oh, were not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unblest by Thee!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Christian, walk carefully: danger is near!
On in thy journey with trembling and fear;
Snares from without, and temptations within,
Seek to entice thee once more into sin.
Christian, walk carefully: danger is near!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Christian, walk cheerfully through the fierce storm,
Dark though the sky with its threats of alarm;
Soon will the clouds and the tempest be o'er,
Then with thy Saviour thou'It rest evermore.
Christian, walk cheerfully: through the fierce storm.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Christian, walk prayerfully: oft wilt thou fall,
If thou forget on thy Saviour to call:
Safe thou shalt walk through each trial and care,
If thou art clad in the armour of prayer.
Christian, walk prayerfully: fear lest thou fall.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Christian, walk hopefully: sorrow and pain
Cease when the haven of rest thou shalt gain:
Then from the lips of the Judge, thy reward-
Enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.
Christian, walk hopefully: rest thou shalt gain.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Hark! 'Tis the watchman's cry,
Awake, brethren, wake!
Jesus Himself is nigh,
Wake, brethren, wake!
Sleep is for sons of night,
Ye are children of the light,
Yours is the glory bright,
Wake, brethren, wake!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Call to each wakening band,
Watch, brethren, watch!
Clear is our Lord's command,
Watch, brethren, watch!
Be ye as men that wait,
Ready at their Master's gate,
E'en though He tarry late,
Watch, brethren, watch!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Heed we the Master's call,
Work, brethren, work!
There's room enough for all:
Work, brethren, work!
This vineyard of the Lord
Constant labour doth afford;
Yours is a sure reward,
Work, brethren, work!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Hear we the Shepherd's voice,
Pray, brethren, pray!
Would ye His heart rejoice?-
Pray, brethren, pray!
Sin calls for ceaseless care,
Weakness needs the Strong One near;
Long as ye tarry here,
Pray, brethren, pray!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O I love to walk with Jesus
Like the publican of old,
When He gathered them about Him
And the blessed tidings told;
How He came to bring deliv'rance
To the captives in distress,
Take away our ev'ry burden,
Giving perfect peace and rest

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I will follow where He leadeth,
I will pasture where He feedeth
I will follow all the way, Lord,
I will follow Jesus ev'ry day.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O I love to walk with Jesus
Like the man of long ago,
Who had tarried by the wayside
Near the gates of Jericho;
Jesus heard his cry for mercy,
Gave him back his sight that day,
And immediately he followed
Jesus all along the way.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O I love to walk with Jesus
All the way to Calv'ry's brow,
Gaze upon that scene of suff'ring,
While my tears of sorrows flow;
There He tells me how He loves me,
Takes my ev'ry sin away;
So I follow Him so gladly,
Lead me anywhere He may.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O sometime I'll walk with Jesus
In the land of endless day,
When our journey here is over
And we've reached our home to stay;
Then I'll walk with Him forever,
Sing His praises o'er and o'er,
Laugh and shout, and ever tell Him
That I love Him more and more.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sometimes it seems so very hard to do what God is asking,
It cuts across the grain of selfish pride;
But when we give our all to Him without a reservation,
It brings such peace and joy down deep inside.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Obedience brings a blessing,
Obedience brings a blessing,
It always works: it never fails, I've found;
Just daring to step out upon the promises of Jesus,
Will always work; it never fails to bring the blessing down.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Then Jonah heard the voice of God say, 'Be My missionary,'
He tho't there was no way he could obey;
But when his disobedience caused him lots of pain and trouble,
He found it was not hard to go God's way.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Don't let your life become so crowded with the task of living,
That you have no time left to seek the Lord;
Don't let Him have to slow you down to get His message to you,
Obedience always brings its own reward.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of kindness,
Sowing in the noon tide and the dewy eves;
Waiting for the harvest and the time of reaping,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Bringing in the sheaves,
Bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows,
Fearing neither clouds nor winter's chilling breeze;
By and by the harvest, and the labor ended.
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Go then ever, weeping, sowing for the Master,
Tho' the loss sustained our spirit often grieves;
When our weeping's over, He will bid us welcome.
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Hark! 'tis the shepherd's voice I hear,
Out in the desert dark and drear,
Calling the sheep who've gone astray,
Far from the shepherd's fold away,

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandering ones to Jesus.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Who'll go and help this Shepherd kind,
Help Him the wandering ones to find?
Who'll bring the lost ones to the fold,
Where they'll be sheltered from the cold.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Out in the desert hear their cry,
Out on the mountains wild and high,
Hark! 'tis the Master speaks to thee,
Go find my sheep where-e'er they be.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
If to Christ our only King
Men redeemed we strive to bring,
Just one way may this be done-
We must win them one by one.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
So you bring the one next to you,
And I'll bring the one next to me;
In all kinds of weather, we'll all work together,
And see what can be done;
If you'll bring the one next to you,
And I bring the one next to me,
In no time at all we'll have them all,
So win them, win them one by one.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Side by side we stand each day,
Saved are we, but lost are they;
They will come if we but dare
Speak a word backed up by prayer.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Only cowards dare refuse,
Dare this gift of God mis-use;
Ere some friends goes to his grave,
Speak a word his soul to save.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Not for hope of great reward
Turn men's hearts unto the Lord;
Just to see a saved man smile
Makes the effort well worth while.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Do not wait until some deed of greatness you may do,
Do not wait to shed your light afar;
To the many duties ever near you now be true,
Brighten the corner where you are.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Brighten the corner where you are!
Brighten the corner where you are!
Someone far from harbour you may guide across the bar,
Brighten the corner where you are.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Just above are clouded skies that you may help to clear,
Let not narrow self your way debar;
Tho' into one heart alone may fall your song of cheer,
Brighten the corner where you are.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Here for all your talent you may surely find a need,
Here reflect the Bright and Morning Star;
Even from your humble hand the bread of life may feed,
Brighten the corner where you are.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I'll tell to all that God is love;
For the world has never known
The great compassion of His heart
For the wayward and the lone.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Till the whole world knows,
Till the whole world knows,
I will shout and sing of Christ my King,
Till the whole world knows

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I'll tell of mercy's boundless tide,
Like the waters of the sea,
That covers ev'ry sin of man;
Tis salvation full and free

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'll tell of grace that keeps the soul,
Of abiding peace within,
Of faith that overcomes the world,
With its tumult and its din

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Eternal glory is the goal
That awaits the sons of light;
Eternal darkness, black as death,
For the children of the night

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
How shall they hear, who have not heard
News of a Lord who loved and came;
Nor known his reconciling word,
Nor learned to trust a Saviour's name?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
To all the world, to every place,
Neighbours and friends far-off lands,
Preach the good news of saving grace;
Go while the great commission stands.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Whom shall I send? who hears the call,
Constant in prayer, through toil and pain,
Telling of one who died for all,
To bring a lost world home again?

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Lord: here am I: Your firm impart
To this poor cold self-centred soul:
Touch but my lips, my hands, my heart,
And make a world for Christ my goal.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Spirit of love, within us move;
Spirit of truth, in power come down!
So shall they hear and find and prove
Christ is their life, their joy, their crown.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I love to tell the story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
I love to tell the Story,
Because I know 'tis true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I love to tell the Story!
Will be my theme in glory,
To tell the Old-Old story,
Of Jesus and His love.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I love to tell the Story:
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the Story
It did so much for me;
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I love to tell the Story:
Is pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the Story:
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God's own Holy Word.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I love to tell the Story:
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
Will be the old, old Story.
That I have loved so long.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Christ hath redeemed us sing the glad word!
Mercy's sweet, message be telling.
How, through the ransom made by His blood,
Christ now within us is dwelling.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Christ hath redeemed us Praise to His name!
Praise Him, ye angels in glory!
Christ hath redeemed us, bearing our shame;
Tell out the wonderful story!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Christ hath redeemed us making us free,
Free from the sins that enslaved us;
Never in bondage more can we be,
Trusting in Him who hath saved us.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Christ hath redeemed us we are His own,
Purchased by blood – He will hold us;
Nor will He ever leave us alone,
Safely His arms shall enfold us.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Christ hath redeemed us soon with the throng
Gathered in glory we'll meet Him;
Oh, with what rapture join in the song,
When face to face we shall greet Him!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Of gifts and pow'rs miraculous
Endowments rare we sing,
Equipment of anointed hearts
Shed forth by Christ the King,
Design'd from heaven God's light and pow'r
To helpless earth to bring.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O blest diversity of gifts,
The Spirit's Super-Sense
Strong currents of Infinity,
Gleams of Omniscience,
Outpourings of Almightiness,
That Risen Hands dispense!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O blessed proofs of living love
In Apostolic days,
Rejected long by formal minds-
Now, to God's endless praise,
Re-risen in this later age
Like dawn's returning blaze!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Shine forth in richer radiance,
Break out in rarer might,
In miracles and mighty signs,
In this earth's darkling night,
That once again Thy Church may be
Victorious in the fight.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
O may Thy members, Mighty Christ,
Most earnestly desire,
Most covetously thirst once more,
Most fervently aspire,
Till each arises furnished new
With ministries of fire!

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Shall we neglect God's glorious plan
His gospel to speed?
Shall we despise rear instruments
Of evangelic deed?
Lord, once again give gifts to men
In this late hour of need.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When first the risen Lord of pow'r
His chosen ones sent forth,
A charge He gave that solemn hour,
To preach His saving worth.
Go ye, said He, to all mankind;
Declare My Word, and ye shall find:
These signs shall surely follow them
Who on My Name believe.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
No demon shall before them stand,
No poison do them harm;
Nor subtle serpent in their hand
Cause pain or dread alarm.
For Satan's kingdom He o'ercame,
To give His people right to claim:
These signs shall surely follow them
Who on My Name believe.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
They shall with other tongues declare
The wonders of their God;
The sick beneath their hands by prayer,
Shall rise, to prove My Word,
So let it be! Firm as His throne
Stands this clear promise to His own:
These signs shall surely follow them
Who on My Name believe.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Crowned with the flame of Pentecost,
A faithful, fearless band
Proclaimed His Name a ransomed host
Arose from every land.
The Lord worked with them from on High,
His proven Word could none deny:
These signs shall surely follow them
Who on My Name believe.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
No word of Thine is void of power;
No promise, Lord, is vain.
Be this a Pentecostal hour-
Confirm Thy Word again!
Nor can'st Thou fail! Thou art the same
As when of old Thou did'st proclaim:
These signs shall surely follow them
Who on My Name believe.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Are you looking for the fullness of
the blessing of the Lord
In your heart and life today?
Claim the promise of your Father,
come according to His word,
In the blessed old time way.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
He will fill your heart today to overflowing,
As the Lord commandeth you,
Bring your vessels, not a few,
He will fill your heart today to overflowing
With the Holy Ghost and pow'r.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Bring your empty earthen vessels,
clean thro' Jesus precious blood,
Come, ye needy, one and all;
And in human consecration wait
before the throne of God
Till the Holy Ghost shall come.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Like the cruise of oil unfailing is
His grace for ever more,
And His love unchanging still;
And according to His promise with
the Holy Ghost and pow'r,
He will every vessel fill.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Joys are flowing like a river,
Since the Comforter has come;
He abides with us for ever,
Makes the trusting heart His home.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Blessed quietness, holy quietness,
What assurance in my soul!
On the stormy sea, He speaks peace to me
How the billows cease to roll.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Bringing life, and health and gladness,
All around this heav'nly Guest,
Banished unbelief and sadness,
Changed our weariness to rest.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Like the rain that falls from heaven,
Like the sunlight from the sky,
So the Holy Ghost is given,
Coming on us from on high.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
See, a fruitful field is growing,
Blessed fruit of righteousness;
And the streams of life are flowing
In the lonely wilderness.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
What a wonderful salvation,
Where we always see His face!
What a perfect habitation,
What a quiet resting place!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Come, Holy Ghost, Creator, come
From Thy bright heavenly throne,
Come, take possession of our souls,
And make them all thy own.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Thou who art called the Paraclete,
Best gift of God above,
The Living Spring, the Living Fire,
Sweet unction and true love.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thou who are sev'n fold in thy grace,
Finger of God's right hand;
His promise, teaching little ones,
To speak and understand.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O guide our minds with thy blest light,
With love our hearts inflame;
And with thy strength which ne'er decays
Confirm our mortal frame.

sections.title: Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Through Thee may we the Father know,
Through Thee th'eternal Son,
And Thee the Spirit of them both,
Thrice-blessed Three in One.

sections.title: Verse 7
sections.lyrics:
All glory to the Father be,
With His co-equal Son,
The same to thee, great Paraclete,
While endless ages run.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Long ago in days of old, stood a man of God we're told,
As he talked to Elijah that day;
His request he did repeat, standing at Elijah's feet,
A double portion I can hear him say.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Give me, Lord, a double portion, pour Thy Spirit on me,
Thru eyes of faith Thy wondrous works I can see;
But I need Thy helping hand, in this troubled, sinful land,
Give me, Lord, a double portion from Thee.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
As Elijah stood that day, to Elisha, he did say,
Ask me what I shall do unto thee
And Elisha then replied, walking at Elijah's side,
A double portion, let it fall on me.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Lord, I always to Thee pray, just for strength from day to day,
But I see there's so much to be done,
That I have to kneel a new and this favour ask of you,
A double portion this fight must be won.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There shall be showers of blessing
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
Sent from the Saviour above.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There shall be showers of blessing
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There shall be showers of blessing
Send them upon us, O Lord!
Grant to us now a refreshing;
Come, and now honour Thy Word.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
There shall be showers of blessing
Oh, that today they might fall,
Now, as to God we're confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
There shall be showers of blessing,
If we but trust and obey;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
If we let God have His way.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O spread the tidings round, wherever man is found,
Wherever human hearts and human woes abound;
Let every Christian tongue proclaim the joyful sound:
The Comforter has come!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
The Comforter has come, The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from Heav'n, The Father's promise giv'n;
O spread the tidings round, Wherever man is found-
The Comforter has come!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The long, long night is past, the morning breaks at last,
And hushed the dreadful wail and fury of the blast,
As o'er the golden hills the day advances fast!
The Comforter has come!

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O boundless love divine! how shall this tongue of mine
To wond'ring mortals tell the matchless grace divine,
That I, a child of hell, should in His image shine!
The Comforter has come!

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
The power! The power!
Gives vict'ry over sin and purity within;
The power! The power!
The power they had at Pentecost.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Come, Thou Almighty King,
Help us your name to sing.
Help us to praise!
Father all-glorious,
O'er all victorious
Come and reign over us,
Ancient of Days.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Come, Thou incarnate Word,
Gird on Thy mighty sword:
Our prayer attend;
Come and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success;
Spirit of holiness,
On us descend!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Come, Holy Comforter,
Your sacred witness bear.
In this glad hour;
Thou who almighty art,
Now rule in every heart,
And ne'er from us depart,
Spirit of power!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
To you, great One in Three,
The highest praises be,
Hence, ever more!
Your sovereign majesty
May we in glory see.
And to eternity
Love and adore.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
God is here, and that to bless us
With the Spirit's quickening power;
See the cloud already bending,
Waits to drop the graceful shower.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Let it come, O Lord, we pray Thee,
Let the shower of blessing fall;
We are waiting, we are waiting,
Oh, revive the hearts of all.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
God is here! We feel his presence
In this consecrated place;
But we need the soul refreshing
Of His free unbounded grace.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
God is here! Oh, then, believing,
Bring to Him our one desire;
That His love may now be kindled,
Till its flame each heart inspire.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Saviour, grant the prayer we offer,
While in simple faith we bow,
From the windows of Thy mercy
Pour us out a blessing now.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Spirit of God in the clear running waters,
Blowing to greatness the trees on the hill,
Spirit of God in the finger of morning,

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Fill the earth, bring it to birth and blow where you will,
Blow, blow, blow till I be but breath of the Spirit blowing in me.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I saw the scar of a year that lay dying,
Heard the lament of a lone whip-poor-will,
Spirit of God, see that cloud crying,

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Come as the light- to us reveal
Our emptiness and woe;
And lead us in those paths of life
Where all the righteous go.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Come as the fire- and purge our hearts,
Like sacrificial flame;
Let our whole soul an offering be
To our Redeemer's name.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Come as the dew- and sweetly bless
This consecrated hour;
May barrenness rejoice to own
Thy fertilising power.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Come as the dove- and spread Thy wings,
The wings of peaceful love;
And let Thy church on earth become
Blest as the church above.

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Come as the wind- with rushing sound
And Pentecostal grace;
That all of woman born may see
The glory of Thy face.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Come, Holy Ghost, our hearts inspire;
Let us Thine influence prove,
Source of the old prophetic fire,
Fountain of light and love.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Come, Holy Ghost, for, moved by Thee,
The prophets wrote and spoke;
Unlock the truth, Thyself the Key,
Unseal the sacred book.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Expand thy wings, celestial Dove,
Brood o'er our nature's night;
On our disordered spirits move,
And let there now be light.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
God, through Himself, we then shall know,
If Thou within us shine;
And sound, with all Thy saints below,
The depths of love divine.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
To the work! To the work! we are servants of God,
Let us follow the path that our Master has trod;
With the balm of His counsel our strength to renew,
Let us do with our might what our hands find to do.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on,
Let us hope,
Let us watch,
And labour till the Master comes.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
To the work! To the work! let the hungry be fed,
To the fountain of life let the weary be led!
In the cross and its banner our glory shall be,
While we herald the tidings, Salvation is free!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
To the work! To the work! there is labour for all,
For the kingdom of darkness and error shall fall:
And the name of Jehovah exalted shall be,
In the loud-swelling chorus, Salvation is free!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
To the work! To the work! in the strength of the Lord,
And a robe and a crown shall our labour reward,
When the home of the faithful our dwelling shall be,
And we shout with the ransomed, Salvation is free!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Must I go, and empty–handed,
Thus my dear Redeemer meet?
Not one day of service give Him,
Lay no trophy at His feet?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Must I go, and empty-handed?
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him:
Must I empty-handed go?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Not at death I shrink or falter,
For my Saviour saves me now;
But to meet Him empty-handed,
Thought of that now clouds my brow.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O the years in sinning wasted,
Could I but recall them now,
I would give them to my Saviour,
To His will I'd gladly bow.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O ye saints, arouse, be earnest,
Up and work while yet is day
Ere the night of death o'er take thee,
Strive for souls while still you may.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Rescue the perishing,
Care for the dying,
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave;
Weep o'ver the erring one,
Lift up the fallen,
Tell them of Jesus, the mighty to save.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Rescue the perishing,
Care for the dying;
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Though they are slighting Him,
Still He is waiting,
Waiting the penitent child to receive.
Plead with them earnestly,
Plead with them gently;
He will forgive if they only believe.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Down in the human heart,
Crushed by the tempter,
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore;
Touched by a loving hand,
Wakened by kindness,
Chords that were broken will vibrate once more.

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The harvest call comes o'er the wave,
I'll go, I'll go;
And seek some struggling soul to save,
I'll go, I'll go.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I'll go,
And press the fight,
Against the foe;
I'll spread the gospel light,
I'll go, I'll go.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The harvest calls, the fields are white,
I'll go, I'll go;
And labour there for God and right,
I'll go, I'll go.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Lost souls are wand'ring in the night,
I'll go, I'll go
And strive to lead them to the light.
I'll go, I'll go.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Go, labour on, spend and be spent,
Thy joy to do the Father's will;
It is the way the Master went,
Should not the servant tread it still?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Go labour on; 'tis not for nought,
Thy earthly loss is heavenly gain;
Men heed thee, love thee, praise thee not,
The Master praises: what are men?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Men die in darkness at your side,
Without a hope to cheer the tomb;
Take up the torch, and wave it wide,
The torch that lights time's thickest gloom.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Toil on, and in thy toil rejoice,
For toil comes rest, for exile home;
Soon shalt thou hear the Bridegroom's voice,
The midnight peal, 'Behold, I come!'

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When Jesus comes to reward His servants,
Whether it be noon or night,
Faithful to Him will He find us watching,
With our lamps all trimmed and bright?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Oh, can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the souls bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
If, at the dawn of the early morning,
He shall call us one by one,
When to the Lord we restore our talents,
Will He answer thee, Well done.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Have we been true to the trust He left us?
Do we seek to do our best?
If in our hearts there is naught condemn us,
We shall have a glorious rest.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Blessed are those whom the Lord finds watching,
In His glory they shall share;
If He shall come at the dawn or midnight,
Will He find us watching there?

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
In the vineyard of the Lord,
There is work for all to do;
Will you go and work today,
With a purpose strong and true?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Heed the call, brother dear,
For workers today;
Let your eyes see the need
Of workers, today.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Brother, sister, hear the call!
All along, your aid afford;
Let us strive to save the lost
Strive to save by work and word.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Mark the spirit's direful fate,
Wheresoever sin is found;
Come, and lend a helping hand,
Let the shackles be unbound.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Oh, for workers strong and brave,
Who will lift the banner high;
So the lost can see the way,
To the mansions in the sky.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Fading away like the stars of the morning,
Losing their light in the glorious sun
Thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling,
Only remembered by what we have done.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Only remembered, only remembered,
Only remembered by what we have done;
Thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling,
Only remembered by what we have done.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Shall we be missed, though by others succeeded,
Reaping the fields we in spring-time have sown?
Yes, but the sowers must pass from their labours,
Ever remembered by what they have done.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Only the truth that in life we have spoken,
Only the seed that on earth we have sown;
These shall pass onward when we are forgotten,
Fruits of the harvest and what we have done.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Oh, when the Saviour shall make up His jewels,
When the crowns of rejoicing are won,
Then shall His weary and faithful disciples
All be remembered by what they have done.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Lord, speak to me that I may speak
In living echoes of Thy tone;
As Thou has sought so let me seek
Thy erring children, lost and lone.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh, lead me, Lord, that I may lead
The wandering and the wavering feet;
O feed me, Lord, that I may feed
Thy hungering ones with manna sweet.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Oh, strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the Rock and strong in Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubled sea.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Oh, teach me, Lord, that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost impart;
And wing my words, that they may reach
The hidden depths of many a heart.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Oh, give Thine own sweet rest to me,
That I may speak with soothing power
A word in season, as from Thee
To weary ones in needful hour.

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
O fill me with Thy fulness, Lord,
Until my very heart o'er flow;
In kindling tho't and glowing word,
Thy love to tell, Thy praise to show.

sections.title: Verse 7
sections.lyrics:
Oh, use me, Lord, use even me,
Just as Thou wilt, and how, and where;
Until Thy blessed face I see,
Thy rest, Thy joy, Thy glory share.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I am thinking today of that beautiful land
I shall reach when the sun goeth down;
When thro' wonderful grace by my Saviour I stand,
Will there be any stars in my crown?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Will there be any stars, any stars in my crown,
When at evening the sun goeth down?
When I wake with the blest in the mansions of rest,
Will there be any stars in my crown?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
In the strength of the Lord let me labour and pray,
Let me watch as a winner of souls;
That bright stars may be mine in the glorious day,
When His praise like the sea-billow rolls.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Oh, what joy it will be when His face I behold,
Living gems at His feet to lay down;
It would sweeten my bliss in the city of gold,
Should there be any stars in my crown.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When upon life's billows you are tempest toss'd,
When you are discouraged thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings, name them one by one
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Count your blessings, name them one by one,
Count your blessings, see what God hath done;
Count your blessings, name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Are you ever burden'd with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, ev'ry doubt will fly,
And you will be singing as the days go by.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When you look at others with their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold,
Count your many blessings, money cannot buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
So amid the conflict, whether great or small,
Do not be discouraged, God is over all,
Count your many blessings, angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to your journey's end.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O Watchman on the mountainheight,
Proclaim the coming day;
Behold the spires of golden fires
Point upward far away.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O Watchman, bid the sleeping Church
Awake, arise, and pray;
The heavenly Bridegroom soon will come,
And now is on His way.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All hail to Zion's glorious King,
By prophets long foretold;
Praise Him in song, ye angel throng,
Strike all your harps of gold.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I love, I love my Master,
I will not go out free!
For He is my Redeemer;
He paid the price for me.
I would not leave His service,
It is so sweet and blest;
And in the weariest moments
He gives the truest rest.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
My Master shed His life-blood
My vassal life to win,
And save me from the bondage
Of tyrant self and sin.
He chose me for His service,
And gave me power to choose
That blessed, perfect freedom,
Which I shall never lose.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I would not halve my service,
His only it must be!
His only—Who so loved me,
And gave Himself for me.
Rejoicing and adoring,
Henceforth my song shall be—
I love, I love my Master,
I will not go out free!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sound the alarm! Let the watchman cry!
Up! For the day of the Lord is nigh;
Who will escape from the wrath to come?
Who have a place in the soul's bright home?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Sound the alarm, watchman! Sound the alarm!
For the Lord will come with a conquering arm;
And the hosts of sin, as their ranks advance,
Shall wither and fall at His glance.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Sound the alarm! Let the cry go forth,
Swift as the wind, o'er the realms of earth
Flee to the Rock where the soul may hide!
Flee to the Rock! In its cleft abide!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Sound the alarm on the mountain's brow!
Plead with the lost by the wayside now:
Warn them to come and the truth embrace;
Urge them to come and be saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
God give His people strength.
If we believe in His way,
He's swift to repay,
All those who bear the burden of the day.
God gives His people strength.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
God gives His people hope.
If we but trust in His word,
Our prayers are always heard.
He warmly welcomes anyone who's erred.
God gives His people hope.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
God gives His people love,
If we but open wide our heart,
He's sure to do His part;
He's always the first to make a start.
God gives His people love.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
God gives His people peace.
When sorrow fills us to the brim,
And courage grows dim,
He lays to rest our restlessness in Him.
God gives His people peace.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
While passing thro' this world of sin,
And others your life shall view,
Be clean and pure without, within
Let others see Jesus in you.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Let others see Jesus in you,
Let others see Jesus in you;
Keep telling the story, be faithful and true,
Let others see Jesus in you.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Your life's a book before their eyes,
They're reading it thro' and thro';
Say, does it point them to the skies,
Do others see Jesus in you?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
What joy 'twill be at set of sun,
In mansions beyond the blue,
To find some souls that you have won;
Let others see Jesus in you.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Then live for Christ both day and night,
Be faithful, be brave and true,
And lead the lost to life and light;
Let others see Jesus in you.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O brother, have you told how the Lord forgave?
Let us hear you tell it over once again;
Thy coming to the cross where He died to save,
Let us hear you tell it over once again.
Are you walking now in His blessed light?
Are you cleansed from every guilty stain?
Is He your joy by day and your song by night?
Let us hear you tell it over once again.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Let us hear you tell it over once again, tell it over once again;
Tell the sweet and blessed story,
It will help you on to glory-
Let us hear you tell it over once again.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
I cannot bear my burdens alone;
I must tell Jesus! I must tell Jesus!
Jesus can help me, Jesus alone.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O how the world to evil allures me!
O how my heart is tempted to sin!
I must tell Jesus, and He will help me
Over the world the vict'ry to win.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Are you weary, are you heavyhearted?
Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus;
Are you grieving over joys departed?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus,
He is a friend that's well known;
You have no other such a friend or brother,
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Do the tears flow down your cheeks unbidden?
Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus;
Have you sins that to man's eyes are hidden?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Do you fear the gath'ring clouds of sorrow?
Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus;
Are you anxious what shall be tomorrow?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Are you troubled at the thought of dying?
Tell it to Jesus, tell it to Jesus;
For Christ's coming Kingdom are you sighing?
Tell it to Jesus alone.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all wants and wishes known;
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the temper's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless;
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His Word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
May I thy consolation share,
Till, from Mount Pisgah's lofty height,
I view my home, and take my flight:
This robe of flesh I'll drop, and rise
To seize the everlasting prize;
And shout, while passing through the air,
Farewell, farewell, Sweet hour of prayer.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Central's never busy, always on the line,
You may hear from heaven, almost any time.
Is a royal service free for one and all-
When you get in trouble give this royal line a call.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Telephone to glory, O what joy divine!
I can feel the current moving on the line;
Built by God the Father for His loved and own-
We may talk to Jesus through this royal telephone.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There will be no charges, telephone is free;
It was built for service, just for you and me.
There will be no waiting on this royal line-
Telephone to glory always answers just in time.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Fail to get the answer, Satan's crossed your wire
By some strong delusion, or some base desire.
Take away obstructions- God is on the throne-
And you'll get the answer thro' this royal telephone.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
If your line is grounded, and connection true
Has been lost with Jesus, tell you what to do:
Pray'r and faith and promise mend the broken wire,
Till your soul is burning with the Pentecostal fire.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Carnal combinations cannot get control
Of this line to glory, anchored in the soul.
Storm and trial cannot disconnect the line
Held in constant keeping by the Father's hand divine.

sections.title: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
In the midst of faults and failures, stand by me;
In the midst of faults and failures, stand by me,
When I do the best I can, and my friends misunderstand,
Thou who knowest all about me, stand by me.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
In the midst of persecution, stand by me;
In the midst of persecution, stand by me,
When my foes in battle array undertake to stop my way,
Thou who saved Paul and Silas, stand by me.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When I'm growing old and feeble, stand by me;
When I'm growing old and feeble, stand by me,
When my life becomes a burden, and I'm nearing chilly Jordan,
O thou Lily of the Valley, stand by me.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What a Friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear
All because we do not carry,
Everything to God in prayer.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged,
Take it to the Lord in prayer,
Can we find a friend so faithful.
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness
Take it to the Lord in prayer!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Are we weak and heavy-laden?
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake Thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer;
In His arms He'll take and shield thee,
Thou will find a solace there.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Pass me not, O gentle Saviour,
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry!
While on others Thou art calling,
Do not pass me by!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Let me at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief;
Kneeling there in deep contrition
Help my unbelief.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Trusting only in Thy merit,
Would I seek Thy face;
Heal my wounded, broken spirit,
Save me by Thy grace.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Thou the spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me;
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
Whom in heav'n but Thee?

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Behold, the days are coming, says
the Lord our God,
When I will make a new covenant
with the house of Israel.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Grant to us, O Lord, a heart
renewed;
Recreate in us your own Spirit,
Lord!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Deep within their being I will
implant my law:
I will write it in their hearts.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And for all their faults I will grant
forgiveness;
Never more will I remember their
sins.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Open my eyes, that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp, and set me free.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see:
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit divine!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Open my ears, that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wave-notes fall on my ear,
Ev'rything false will disappear.

sections.title: Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see:
Open my ears, illumine me,
Spirit divine!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Open my mouth, and let me bear
Tidings of mercy ev'rywhere;
Open my heart, and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share.

sections.title: Chorus 3
sections.lyrics:
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see:
Open my heart, illumine me,
Spirit divine!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Open my mind, that I may read
More of Thy love in word or deed
What shall I fear while yet Thou dost lead?
Only for light from Thee I plead,

sections.title: Chorus 4
sections.lyrics:
Silently now I wait for Thee
Ready, my God, Thy will to see
Open my mind, illumine me,
Spirit divine.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Open my way that I may bring
Trophies of grace to Thee, my King;
Echoed in love Thy word shall out-ring,
Sweet as the note that angels sing,

sections.title: Chorus 5
sections.lyrics:
Silently, now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see,
Open my way, illumine me,
Spirit divine.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I'll never forget that wonderful hour,
When I felt His power, and I prayed through;
All Heaven came down and Glory abounded,
The angels resounded when I prayed through.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
And now I'm His and He is mine,
blest assurance so divine;
I'm feasting on the living bread,
since I prayed through;
I can't explain just how I feel,
But praise God! I know it's real,
Because I stayed down on my knees
til I prayed through.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Stay Thou near by;
Temptations lose their power,
When Thou art nigh.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide,
Or life is vain.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I need Thee every hour,
Teach me Thy will;
And Thy rich promises
In me fulfil.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
I need Thee every hour,
Most Holy One;
Oh, make me Thine indeed,
Thou blessed Son!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Let the beauty of Jesus be seen in me,
All His wonderful passion and purity,
May His Spirit divine all my being refine,
Let the beauty of Jesus be seen in me.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When your burden is heavy and hard to bear,
When your neighbours refuse all your load to share;
When you're feeling so blue, don't know just what to do,
Let the beauty of Jesus be seen in you.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When somebody has been so unkind to you,
Some word spoken that pierces you thru, and thru,
Think how He was beguiled, spat upon and reviled,
Let the beauty of Jesus be seen in you.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
From the dawn of the morning to close of day,
In example in deeds and in all you say;
Lay your gifts at His feet, ever strive to keep sweet,
Let the beauty of Jesus be seen in you.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
God, give us Christian homes!
Homes where the Bible is loved and taught,
Homes where the Master's will is sought,
Homes crowned with beauty Thy love hath wrought;
God, give us Christian homes!
God, give us Christian homes!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
God, give us Christian homes!
Homes where the father is true and strong,
Homes that are free from the bright of wrong,
Homes that are joyous with love and song;
God, give us Christian homes!
God, give us Christian homes!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
God, give us Christian homes!
Homes where the mother, in queenly quest,
Strives to show others Thy way is best,
Homes where the Lord is an honoured guest;
God, give us Christian homes!
God, give us Christian homes!

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
His truth is marching on.

sections.title: Verse 2
Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
His day is marching on.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He has sounded forth the trumpet that shall never call retreat;
He is sifting out the hearts of men before His judgment seat.
O be swift, my soul, to answer Him! Be jubilant, my feet!
Our God is marching on.

sections.title: Chorus 3
sections.lyrics:
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Our God is marching on.

sections.title: Verse 4
Chorus 4
sections.lyrics:
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
Glory! Glory, hallelujah!
While God is marching on.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When the hosts of Israel, led by God,
Round the walls of Jericho softly trod;
Trusting in the Lord, they felt the conqu'ror's tread,
By faith they saw the victory ahead.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Victory ahead! Victory ahead!
Thro' the blood of Jesus, victory ahead,
Trusting in the Lord, I hear the conq'ror's tread,
By faith I see the victory ahead.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
David, with a shepherd's sling and five stones,
Met the giant on the field all alone;
Trusting in the Lord, he knew what God had said,
By faith he saw the victory ahead.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Daniel prayed unto the Lord thrice each day,
Then unto the lion's den led the way;
Trusting in the Lord, he did not fear or dread,
By faith he saw the victory ahead.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Often with the carnal mind I was tried,
Asking for deliverance oft I cried;
Trusting in the Lord, I reckoned I was dead,
By faith I saw the victory ahead.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When like those who've gone before to that land,
By death's river cold and dark I shall stand;
Trusting in the Lord, I will not fear or dread,
By faith I see the victory ahead.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before
Christ, the Royal Master,
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle,
See His banners go!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
At the name of Jesus,
Satan's host doth flee;
On, then, Christian soldiers,
On to victory;
Hell's foundations quiver
At the shout of praise:
Brothers, lift your voices,
Loud your anthems raise!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Like a mighty army,
Moves the Church of God:
Brothers, we are treading
Where the saints have trod;
We are not divided,
All one body we-
One in hope and doctrine,
One in charity.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Crowns and thrones may perish,
Kingdoms rise and wane,
But the church of Jesus
Constant will remain;
Gates of hell can never
Gainst that church prevail;
We have Christ's own promise,
And that cannot fail.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Onward, then, ye people,
Join our happy throng;
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph-song;
Glory, laud and honour
Unto Christ the King,
This thro' countless ages
Men and angels sing.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Rouse, then, soldiers! Rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward! Forward! Shout aloud, Hosanna!
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Strong to meet the foe, marching on we go,
While our cause we know must prevail;
Shield and banner bright gleaming in the light,
Battling for the right, we ne'er can fail!

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner.
It must not suffer loss.
From vict'ry unto vict'ry
His army shall He lead,
Till every foe is vanquished.
And Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict
In this His glorious day!
Ye that are men, now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger,
And strength to strength oppose.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Stand up! stand up for Jesus!
Stand in His strength alone:
The arm of flesh will fail you–
Ye dare not trust your own:
Put on the gospel armour,
And watching unto prayer,
Where duty calls or danger,
Be never wanting there.

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Ho, my comrades! See the signal
Waving in the sky!
Reinforcements now appearing,
Victory is nigh.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Hold the fort, for I am coming,
Jesus signals still;
Wave the answer back to heaven,
By Thy grace we will.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
See the mighty host advancing,
Satan leading on;
Mighty men around us falling,
Courage almost gone!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
See the glorious banner waving!
Hear the trumpet blow!
In our Leader's name we'll triumph
Over every foe.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Fierce and long the battle rages,
But our help is near;
Onward comes our great Commander,
Cheer, my comrades, cheer!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Christian, seek not yet repose;
Cast thy dreams of ease away,
Thou art in the midst of foes:
Watch and pray.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Principalities and powers,
Mustering their unseen array,
Wait for thine unguarded hours:
Watch and pray.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Gird thy heavenly armour on,
Wear it ever night and day;
Ambushed lies the evil one:
Watch and pray.

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Hear, above all, hear the Lord,
Him thou lovest to obey;
Hide within thy heart His word,
Watch and pray.

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
Watch, as if on that alone
Hung the issue of the day;
Pray that help may be sent down:
Watch and pray.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Master, the tempest is raging!
The billows are tossing high!
The sky is o'er-shadowed with blackness,
No shelter or help is nigh:
Carest Thou not that we perish?
How canst Thou lie asleep,
When each moment so madly is threatening
A grave in the angry deep?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
The winds and the waves shall obey My will!
Peace!… be still!…
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea,
Or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
No waters can swallow the ship where lies
The Master of ocean, and earth, and skies:
They all shall sweetly obey My will;
Peace! Be still! Peace! Be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will;
Peace! Peace! Be still!

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Master, the terror is over,
The elements sweetly rest;
Earth's sun in the calm lake is mirrored,
And heaven's within my breast;
Linger, O blessed Redeemer,
Leave me alone no more:
And with joy I shall make the blest harbour,
And rest on the blissful shore.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
They who know the Saviour shall in Him be strong,
Mighty in the conflict of the right gainst wrong.
This the blessed promise given in God's word,
Doing wondrous exploits, they who know the Lord.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Victory! Victory! Blessed blood-bought victory,
Victory! Victory! Vict'ry all the time.
As Jehovah liveth, strength divine He giveth,
Unto those who know Him vict'ry all the time.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
In the midst of battle be thou not dismayed,
Though the powers of darkness 'gainst thee are arrayed;
God, thy strength, is with thee, causing thee to stand,
Heaven's allied armies wait at thy command.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Brave to bear life's testing, strong the foe to meet,
Walking like a hero midst the furnace heat,
Doing wondrous exploits with the Spirit's sword
Winning souls for Jesus, praise, O praise the Lord.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Am I a soldier of the cross,
A foll'wer of the Lamb?
And shall I fear to own His cause,
Or blush to speak His name?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
And when the battle's over we shall
wear a crown!
Yes, we shall wear a crown! Yes,
we shall wear a crown!
And when the battle's over we shall
wear a crown
In the new Jerusalem.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Must I be carried to the skies
On flow'ry beds of ease,
While others fought to win the
prize,
And sailed thro' bloody seas?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace
To help me on to God?

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Sure, I must fight if I would reign,
Increase my courage, Lord:
I'll bear the toil, endure the pain,
Supported by Thy word.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The God who led His people thro' the parted sea,
And from Egyptian bondage, set
His children free,
Who rain'd down bread from heaven all the pilgram way,
Is the God to whom i pray.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Just the same today, just the same today,
As when He led His people thro'the sea;
His trustful child I'll be, for in His word I see,
The God who doeth wonders is just the same today.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The God who rescued Daniel from
the lion's den,
And from the fiery furnace, sav'd
the three young men,
Who speaks, and constellations will
His voice obey,
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The God who stills the tempest with
a word divine,
And on the clouds of sorrow, makes
His rainbows shine,
Who from the tomb of Jesus rolled
the stone away,
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The God who clothes the lily in its
robe of snow,
Who in the barren desert makes His
rivers flow;
The God who lifts the sinner from
the miry clay,
Is the God to whom I pray.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Till we meet, till we meet
Till we meet at Jesus feet;
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The day Thou gavest, Lord is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We thank Thee that Thy Church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
As o'er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The sun that bids us rest is waking
Our brethren 'neath the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh lips are making
Thy wondrous doings heard on high.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
So be it, Lord: Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands and grows forever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

sections.title: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I need thy presence every passing hour;
What but thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who like thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, Lord abide with me.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I fear no foe, with thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight and tears no bitterness,
Where is death's sting? Where grave thy victory?
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me.

sections.title: Verse 5
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Asleep in Jesus! Blessed sleep!
From which none ever wakes to weep;
A calm and undisturbed repose,
Unbroken by the last of foes.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Asleep in Jesus! Oh how sweet!
To be for such a slumber meet!
With holy confidence to sing,
That death hath lost its venomed sting!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Asleep in Jesus! Peaceful rest!
Whose waking is supremely blest;
No fear, no woe, shall dim the hour
That manifests the Saviour's power.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Asleep in Jesus! Oh for me
May such a blissful refuge be!
Securely shall my ashes lie,
And wait the summons from on high.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Asleep in Jesus! Far from thee
Thy kindred and their graves may be:
But thine is still a blessed sleep,
From which none ever wakes to weep.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We never know at the dawn of day,
Greeting the rising sun,
Whether the reaper shall call away,
Ere that days work is done.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Tomorrow may mean good-by,
We never know when nor why,
God calls us away, when life seems so gay,
Our bodies in dust to lie;
Tomorrow our souls may sigh,
For beauties we've let slip by,
O soul then prepare, sweet heaven to share,
Tomorrow may mean goodby.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We live each day of this earthly life,
As tho it ne'er would end,
Forgetting God in our daily strife,
Grieving this precious friend.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
God guides our footsteps each passing day,
Burdens He will relieve,
Promising freely sufficient grace,
If only we believe.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound, and time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
On that bright and cloudless morning when the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share;
When His chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Let us labour for the Master from the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care;
Then when all of life is over, and our walk on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall arise,
And the splendors immortal shall envelope the skies,
When the angel of death shall no longer destroy,
And the dead shall awaken in the morning of joy.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
In the morning of joy,
In the morning of joy,
We'll be gathered to glory
In the morning of joy;
In the morning of joy.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When the King shall appear, in His beauty on high,
And shall summon His children to the courts of the sky,
Shall the cause of the Lord have been all your employ,
That your soul may be spotless in the morning of joy?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O the bliss of that morn when our loved ones we meet,
With the songs of the ransomed we each other shall greet,
Singing praise to the Lamb, thro' eternity's years,
With the past all forgotten with its sorrows and tears.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
Will your lamps be burning bright?
Will your robes be pure and white?
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
O be ready for that day!
With your sins all wash'd away,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
Will your wearied heart rejoice
At the sound of Jesus' voice?
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
Will the sorrows of the past
All be chang'd to joy at last?
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Lord shall call His own,
Can you stand before the throne?
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,
Will you join the ransom'd host,
Or be found among the lost?
When the Bridegroom cometh by and by,

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When my life-work is ended, and I cross the swelling tide,
When the bright and glorious morning I shall see;
I shall know my Redeemer when I reach the other side,
And His smile will be the first to welcome me.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I shall know Him, I shall know Him,
And redeemed by His side I shall stand;
I shall know Him, I shall know Him
By the print of the nails in His hand.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Oh, the soul-thrilling rapture when I view His blessed face,
And the luster of His kindly beaming eye;
How my full heart will praise Him for the mercy, love, and grace,
That prepare for me a mansion in the sky.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thro' the gates to the city in a robe of spotless white,
He will lead me where no tears will ever fall;
In the glad song of ages I shall mingle with delight:
But I long to meet my Saviour first of all.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When the pearly gates are opened
To a sinner saved by grace,
When thro' everlasting mercy,
I behold my Saviour's face;
When I enter in the mansions
Of the city bright and fair,
I shall have a royal welcome,
For I'll be no stranger there.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I shall be no stranger there,
Jesus will my place prepare;
He will meet me, He will greet me,
I shall be no stranger there.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There my dear Redeemer liveth,
Blessed Lamb upon the throne;
By the crimson marks upon them,
He will surely claim His own
So, whenever sad or lonely,
Look beyond the earthly care;
Weary child of God, remember,
You will be no stranger there.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I have given up all for Jesus-
This vain world is naught to me;
All its pleasures are forgotten
In remembering Calvary.
Though my friends despise, forsake me,
And on me the world looks cold,
I've a Friend that will stand by me
When the pearly gates unfold.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Life's morn will soon be waning,
And its evening bells be tolled,
But my heart will know no sadness
When the pearly gates unfold.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When the voice of Jesus calls me,
And the angels whisper low,
I will lean upon my Saviour
Through the valley as I go:
I will claim His precious promise,
Worth to me the world of gold:
Fear no evil, I'll be with thee
When the pearly gates unfold.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Just beyond the waves of Jordan,
Just beyond its chilling tide,
Blooms the Tree of Life immortal,
And the living waters glide:
In that happy land of spirits
Are there stores of bliss untold,
And the angels are awaiting
Where the pearly gates unfold.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I shall wear a golden crown,
When I get home,
I shall lay my burdens down,
When I get home,
Clad in robes of glory,
I shall sing the story
Of the Lord who bought me,
When I get home.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
When I get home,
When I get home,
All sorrow will be over,
When I get home;
When I get home,
When I get home,
All sorrow will be over,
When I get home.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All the darkness will be past,
When I get home,
I shall see the light at last,
When I get home;
Light from heaven streaming,
O'er my pathway beaming,
Ever guides me onward
Till I get home.

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Storms do not alarm me,
They sometime must cease,
Trials cannot harm me,
For I have blessed peace,
All love left behind me,
I long for no more,
Better things shall find me,
On Canaan's shore.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Let those who will stay in Egyptland,
I am bound for Canaan
Where milk and honey flowing,
Shall ev'ry need supply,
All battles fought and
The victory won,
Peace and joy my portion,
My soul shall rest
On its shore by and by.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Troubles do not fret me,
They cannot abide,
Tho' they may beset me,
In Jesus, I will hide;
All the world's commotion
About me may roar,
There's no stormy ocean
On Canaan's shore.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I in grace abiding,
Am trying to stay,
In the shadow hiding
Of Canaan's perfect day;
All I trust may fail me,
will matter no more,
Nothing can assail me
On Canaan's shore.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Shall we gather at the river,
Where bright angel feet have trod,
With its crystal tide forever
Flowing by the throne of God?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Yes, we'll gather at the river,
The beautiful, the beautiful river,
Gather with the saints at the river,
That flows by the throne of God.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
On the margin of the river,
Washing up its silver spray,
We will walk and worship ever,
All the happy, golden day.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Ere we reach the shining river,
Lay we ev'ry burden down;
Grace our spirits will deliver,
And provide a robe and crown.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
At the shining of the river,
Mirror of the Saviour's face,
Saints whom death will never sever
Raise their songs of saving grace.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Soon we'll reach the silver river,
Soon our pilgrimage will cease;
Soon our happy hearts will quiver
With the melody of peace.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
My Saviour's gone a mansion to prepare,
In yon fair lands;
Adorned it will be with jewels rare,
Not made, not made with hands.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I know, I know, in heav'n for me a mansion stands,
A home, a home, Not made with hands.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
How wonderful the story I've been told,
That in those lands
The gates all are pearl, the streets are gold,
Not made, not made with hands.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Just over there, its splendour I can see,
All fair it stands;
How wonderful this dwelling place for me,
Not made, not made with hands.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
There all the ransom'd robed in spotless white,
Dwell in those lands,
Securely within that home of light,
Not made, not made with hands.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When life is o'er, some morning bright and fair,
I'll leave these lands;
With all the redeemed, a crown to wear,
Not made, not made with hands.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
On Jordan's stormy banks I stand,
And cast a wishful eye,
To Canaan's fair and happy land,
Where my possessions lie.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All o'er all those wide extended plains
Shines one eternal day,
There God the Son for ever reigns
And scatters night away.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
No chilling winds nor pois'nous breath
Can reach that healthful shore;
Sickness and sorrow, pain and death
Are felt and feared no more.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When shall I reach that happy place,
And be for ever blest?
When shall I see the Father's face,
And in His bosom rest?

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I've reached the land of love divine
And all its riches freely mine;
Here shines undimmed one blissful day,
For all my night has passed away.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O Beulah Land, sweet Beulah Land,
As on thy highest mount I stand,
I look away across the sea,
Where mansions are prepared for me,
And view the shining glory shore,
My heav'n, my home for ever more!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
My Saviour comes and walks with me,
And sweet communion here have we;
He gently leads me by His hand,
For this is heaven's border land.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
A sweet perfume upon the breeze
Is borne from ever-vernal trees,
And flow'rs that, never fading, grow
Where streams of life for ever flow.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The zephyrs seem to float to me,
Sweet sounds of heaven's melody,
As angels with the white robed throng
Join in the sweet redemption song.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I have heard of a land on the faraway strand,
is a beautiful home of the soul;
Built by Jesus on high, there we never shall die,
is a land where we never grow old.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
In that beautiful home where we'll never more roam,
We shall be in that sweet by and by;
Happy praise to the King thro' eternity sing,
is a land where we never shall die.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When our work here is done and our life crown is won,
And our troubles and trials are o'er;
All our sorrow will end, and our voices will blend,
With the loved ones who've gone on before.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We read of a place that's called heaven,
It's made for the pure and the free;
These truths in God's word He has given,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
How beautiful heaven must be,
Sweet home of the happy and free;
Fair heaven of rest for the weary,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
In heaven, no drooping, nor pining,
No wishing for elsewhere to be,
God's light is forever there shining,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Pure waters of life there are flowing,
And all who will drink may be free;
Rare jewels of splendor are glowing,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The angels so sweetly are singing,
Up there, by the beautiful sea;
Sweet chords from their harps are ringing,
How beautiful heaven must be.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions bright and blessed,
He'll prepare for us a place.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that willbe!
When we all see Jesus,
We'll sing and shout the victory.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
Clouds will over-spread the sky;
But when trav'ling days are over,
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Let us then be true and faithful,
Trusting, serving ev'ry day;
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Onward to the prize before us!
Soon His beauty we'll behold;
Soon the pearly gates will open,
We shall tread the streets of gold.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Heavenly sunlight, heavenly sunlight,
Flooding my soul with glory divine;
Hallelujah! I am rejoicing,
Singing His praises, Jesus is mine

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Shadows around me, shadows above me,
Never conceal my Saviour and Guide;
He is the light, in Him is no darkness,
Ever I'm walking close to His side.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
In the bright sunlight, ever rejoicing,
Pressing my way to mansions above;
Singing His praises, gladly I'm walking,
Walking in sunlight, sunlight of love.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is a place of quiet rest,
Near to the heart of God,
A place where sin cannot molest,
Near to the heart of God.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O Jesus, blest Redeemer,
Sent from the heart of God,
Hold us, who wait before Thee,
Near to the heart of God.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is a place of comfort sweet,
Near to the heart of God,
A place where we our Saviour meet,
Near to the heart of God.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There is a place of full release,
Near to the heart of God,
A place where all is joy and peace,
Near to the heart of God.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a land of peace and plenty,
and its gates are open wide;
And the pure in heart and holy
in its shelter may abide,
It is not thro' gates of glory
that a soul must enter in;
But all who would find entrance there
must leave the ways of sin.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Come over, come over,
to the land of corn and wine,
There is nothing can compare with
the many holy pleasures there,
Come over, come over,
leave the desert plain below and come away,
Away, come over.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is bread of heaven growing,
in its fair and fertile fields,
And the wine of love its vineyard
to the thirsting mortal yields;
There are mountain heights of glory
that await the trav'lers too,
And blest retreats where empty
souls draw nearer unto God.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Who would stay without its borders,
in the desert dark and drear,
When the luscious grapes of eschol
are so very, very near?
Enter in then with rejoicing,
for the Lord is on your side,
And in His glorious presence
evermore shall abide.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Is a sweet and glorious tho't that comes to me,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on;
Jesus saved my soul from death and now I'm free,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on,
Thru eternity I'll live on,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on,
Thru eternity I'll live on

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When my body's slumb'ring in the cold, cold clay,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on;
There to sleep in Jesus till the judgment day,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When the world's on fire and darkness veils the sun,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on;
Men will cry and to the rocks and mountains run,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on.

sections.title: Verse 4
