sections.lyrics:
In the glory-land, with God upon the throne,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on;
Thru eternal ages singing, home sweet home,
I'll live on, yes, I'll live on.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Hark, hark, my soul! Angelic songs are swelling
O'er earth's green fields and ocean's wave-beat shore;
How sweet the truth those blessed strains are telling
Of that new life when sin shall be no more.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the pilgrims of the night!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Far, far away, like bells at evening pealing,
The voice of Jesus sounds o'er land and sea,
And laden soul by thousands meekly stealing,
Kind Shepherd, turn their weary steps to Thee.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Onward we go, for still we hear them singing,
Come, weary, souls! For Jesus bids you come
And through the dark, its echoes sweetly ringing,
The music of the Gospel leads us home.

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Face to face with Christ, my Saviour,
Face to face- what will it be?
When with rapture I behold Him,
Jesus Christ who died for me!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Face to face I shall behold Him,
Far beyond the starry sky;
Face to face, in all His glory,
I shall see Him by and by!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Only faintly now I see Him,
With the darkling veil between;
But a blessed day is coming,
When His glory shall be seen.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
What rejoicing in His presence,
When are banished grief and pain,
When the crooked ways are straightened
And the dark things shall be plain.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Face to face- O blissful moment!
Face to face to see and know;
Face to face with my Redeemer,
Jesus Christ who loves me so!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When in the better land before the bar we stand,
How deeply grieved our souls may be;
If any lost one there should cry in deep despair,
You never mentioned Him to me

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
You never mentioned Him to me,
You helped me not the light to see;
You met me day by day and knew I was astray,
Yet never mentioned Him to me

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O let us spread the word where'er it may be heard,
Help groping souls the light to see,
That yonder none may say, A you showed me not the way
You never mentioned Him to me

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
A few sweet words may guide a lost one to His side,
Or turn sad eyes on Calvary;
So work as days go by, that yonder none may cry,
You never mentioned Him to me

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Too late, will be for you to cry,
When mercy's day has passed you by!
When solemn night, of dark despair,
Shall come upon you halting there!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Too late, too late, poor trembling soul!
O will this be your fate?
Too late, too late to be made whole!
Too late, too late, too late!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Too late, when death has barred the door,
Your wailings can be heard no more!
Rejected there, thy soul will be
Shut out, thro' all eternity!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Will you not heed the voice today,
Inviting you Christ to obey?
And be prepared to enter there,
A pure and spotless robe to wear?

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
No longer, there in sin abide!
This all important step decide!
Come out, where Christ can touch thy soul,
And at this moment be made whole!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a line that is drawn by rejecting the Lord,
Where the call of His Spirit is lost,
And you hurry along with the pleasure-mad throng-
Have you counted, have you counted the cost?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Have you counted the cost, if your soul should be lost,
Tho' you gain the whole world for your own?
Even now it may be that the line you have crossed,
Have you counted, have you counted the cost?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
You may barter your hope of eternity's morn,
For a moment of joy at the most,
For the glitter of sin and the things it will win-
Have you counted, have you counted the cost?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
While the door of His mercy is open to you,
Ere the depth of His love you exhaust,
Won't you come and be healed, won't you whisper, I yield-
I have counted, I have counted the cost.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a great day coming, a great day coming,
There's a great day coming, by and by;
When the saints and the sinners shall be parted right and left,
Are you ready for that day to come?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Are you ready? Are you ready?
Are you ready for the judgment day?
Are you ready?
Are you ready for the judgment day?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There's a bright day coming, a bright day coming,
There's a bright day coming, by and by;
But its brightness shall only come to them that love the Lord,
Are you ready for that day to come?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There's a sad day coming, a sad day coming,
There's a sad day coming, by and by;
When the sinner shall hear his doom Depart, I know ye not,
Are you ready for that day to come?

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Where will you spend eternity?
This question comes to you and me!
Tell me, what shall your answer be?
Where will you spend eternity?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Eternity! Eternity!
Where will you spend eternity?

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Leaving the strait and narrow way,
Going the downward road today,
Sad will their final ending be,
Lost thro' a long eternity!

sections.title: Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
Eternity! Eternity!
Lost thro' a long eternity!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Repent, believe, this very hour
Trust in the Saviour's grace and power;
Then will your joyous answer be,
Saved through a long eternity!

sections.title: Chorus 3
sections.lyrics:
Eternity! Eternity!
Saved thro' a long eternity!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I dreamed that the great judgment morning
Had dawned and the trumpet had blown;
I dreamed that the nations had gathered
To judgment before the white throne;
From the throne came a bright shining angel,
And stood on the land and the sea,
And swore with his hand raised to heaven,
That time was no longer to be.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
And O, what a weeping and wailing,
As the lost were told of their fate;
They cried for the rocks and the mountains,
They prayed, but their prayer was too late.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The rich man was there, but his money
Had melted and vanished away;
A pauper he stood in the judgment,
His debts were too heavy to pay;
The great man was there, but his greatness,
When death came, was left far behind!
The angel that opened the records,
Not a trace of his greatness could find.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The widow was there with the orphans,
God heard and remembered their cries;
No sorrow in heaven for ever,
God wiped all the tears from their eyes;
The gambler was there and the drunkard,
And the man that had sold them the drink,
With the people who gave him the license,
Together in hell they did sink.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The moral man came to the judgment,
But his self-righteous rags would not do;
The men who had crucified Jesus
Had passed off as moral men, too;
The soul that had put off salvation,
Not tonight; I'll get saved by and by,
No time now to think of religion!
At last they had found time to die.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Sorry, I never knew you, depart from me for ever more;
Sorry, I never knew you, go and serve the one that you served before.

sections.title: Verse 2
Chorus 2
sections.lyrics:
Sorry, I never knew you, I find no record of your birth;
Sorry, I never knew you, go and serve the one you served while on earth.

sections.title: Verse 3
Chorus 3
sections.lyrics:
Daddy, we can't go with you, we must stay on this lovely shore;
Sorry for we still love you, but you cannot be our Daddy anymore.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When I from sleep awakened, with tears in my eyes,
I looked around, and there about me to my great surprise,
I saw my wife and babies, and knew I'd had a dream,
Then down beside my bed I fell, and for mercy did scream;

sections.title: Chorus 4
sections.lyrics:
Father, Who art in glory, in mercy look on me today;
Forgive me let me serve Thee, till the summons comes and calls me away.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O brother, life's journey beginning,
With courage and firmness arise!-
Look well to the course thou art choosing;
Be earnest, be watchful, and wise!
Remember- two paths are before thee,
And both thy attention invite;
But one leadeth on to destruction,
The other to joy and delight.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
God help you to follow His banner,
And serve Him wherever you go;
And when you are tempted, my brother,
God give you the grace to say No!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O brother, yield not to the tempter,
No matter what others may do;
Stand firm in the strength of the Master,
Be loyal, be faithful, and true!
Each trial will make you the stronger,
If you, in the name of the Lord,
Fight manfully under your Leader,
Obeying the voice of His word.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O brother, the Saviour is calling!
Beware of the danger of sin;
Resist not the voice of the Spirit,
That whispers so gently within.
God calls you to enter His service-
To live for Him here, day by day;
And share by and by in the glory
That never shall vanish away.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus bids us shine with a clear pure light,
Like a little candle burning in the night;
In this world of darkness we must shine-
You in your small corner, and I in mine.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus bids us shine, then; for all around,
Many kinds of darkness in this world abound;
Sin and want and sorrow; so we must shine-
You in your small corner, and I in mine.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Standing by a purpose true,
Heeding God's command,
Honour them, the faithful few!
All hail to Daniel's Band!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Dare to be a Daniel!
Dare to stand alone!
Dare to make a purpose firm!
Dare to make it known!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Many mighty men are lost,
Daring not to stand,
Who for God had been a host,
By joining Daniel's Band!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Many giants, great and tall,
Stalking through the land,
Headlong to the earth would fall,
If met by Daniel's Band!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Hold the gospel banner high!
On to victory grand!
Satan and his host defy,
And shout for Daniel's Band

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is a green hill far away,
Without a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven, and let us in.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Oh, dearly, dearly has He loved!
And we must love Him too;
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Father God in heaven, Lord Most High:
Hear your children's prayer, Lord Most High:
Hallowed be your name, Lord Most High
O Lord, hear our prayer.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
May your kingdom come, here on earth;
May your will be done, here on earth,
As it is in heaven, so on earth
O Lord, hear our prayer.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Give us daily bread day by day,
And forgive our sins day by day,
As we too forgive day by day
O Lord, hear our prayer.

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
All things come from you, all are yours
Kingdom, glory, power, all are yours
Take our lives and gifts, all are yours
O Lord, hear our prayer.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful,
The Lord God made them all.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful,
The Lord God made them all.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colours,
He made their tiny wings.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The purple-headed mountain,
The river running by,
The sunset, and the morning
That brightens up the sky.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden,
He made them every one.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has done all things well.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I think when I read the sweet story of old,
When Jesus was here among men,
How He called little children as lambs to His fold,
I should like to have been with them then;
I wish that His hands had been placed on my head,
That His arms had been thrown around me,
And that I might have seen His kind look when He said:
Let the little ones come unto me!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Yet still to His footstool in prayer I may go,
And ask for a share of His love:
And if I now earnestly seek Him below,
I shall see Him and hear Him above.
In that beautiful place He has gone to prepare
For all who are washed and forgiven;
And many dear children are gathering there
For of such is the kingdom of heaven.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
But for thousands and thousands who wonder and fall,
Never heard of that heavenly home;
I should like them to know there is room for them all,
And that Jesus has bid them to come.
I long for the joy of that glorious time,
The sweetest and brightest and best,
When the dear little children of every clime
Shall crowd to arms and be blessed.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a Friend for little children,
Above the bright blue sky;
A Friend who never changeth,
Whose love can never die.
Unlike our friends by nature,
Who change with changing years,
This Friend is always worthy,
The precious name He bears.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There's a home for little children,
Above the bright blue sky;
Where Jesus reigns in glory,
A home of peace and joy.
No home on earth is like it,
Nor can with it compare:
For every one is happy,
Nor could be happier, there.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
There's a crown for little children,
Above the bright blue sky;
And all who look for Jesus
Shall wear it by and by-
A crown of brightest glory,
Which He will then bestow
On all who've found His favour
And loved His name below.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
There's a song for little children,
Above the bright blue sky-
A song that will not weary,
Though sung continually;
A song which even angels
Can never, never sing;
They know not Christ as Saviour,
But worship Him as King.

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
There's a robe for little children,
Above the bright blue sky;
And a harp of sweetest music,
And a palm of victory,
All, all above is treasured,
And found in Christ alone;
Oh, come, dear little children,
That all may be your own.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Tell me the Old, Old Story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the Story simply,
As to a little child,
For I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Tell me the Old, Old Story
Of Jesus and His love!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Tell me the Story slowly,
That I may take it in-
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin.
Tell me the Story often,
For I forget so soon;
The early dew of morning
Has passed away at noon.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Tell me the Story softly,
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember! I'm the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me that Story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble,
A comforter to me.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Tell me the same Old Story,
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear.
Yes, and when that world's glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the Old, Old Story:
AChrist Jesus makes thee whole.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Loving Shepherd of thy sheep,
Keep thy lamb, in safety keep;
Nothing can thy power withstand,
None can pluck me from thy hand.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Loving Saviour, thou didst give
Thine own life that we might live,
And the hands outstretched to bless
Bear the cruel nails' impress.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I would praise thee every day,
Gladly all thy will obey,
Like thy blessed ones above
Happy in thy precious love.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Loving Shepherd, ever near,
Teach thy lamb thy voice to hear;
Suffer not my steps to stray
From the straight and narrow way.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Where thou leadest I would go,
Walking in thy steps below,
Till before my Father's throne
I shall know as I am known.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, Lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
Oh, receive my soul at last!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, oh, leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me:
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thou, O Christ, art all I want;
More than all in Thee I find:
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind:
Just and holy is Thy name,
I am all unrighteousness:
Vile, and full of sin I am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Plenteous grace with Thee is found-
Grace to cover all my sin:
Let the healing streams abound;
Make me, keep me pure within:
Thou of life the Fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee:
Spring Thou up within my heart,
Rise to all eternity.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Gentle Jesus, meek and mild,
Look upon a little child;
Pity my simplicity,
Suffer me to come to thee.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Fain I would to thee be brought:
Blessed Lord, forbid it not:
In the Kingdom of thy grace.
Give a little child a place.

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I love to hear the story
Which angel voices tell
How once the King of Glory
Came down on earth to dwell:
I am both weak and sinful,
But this I surely know:
The Lord came down to save me,
Because He loved me so!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I'm glad my blessed Saviour
Was once a child like me,
To show how pure and holy
His little ones might be;
And if I try to follow
His footsteps here below,
He never will forget me,
Because He loves me so!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
To sing His love and mercy,
My sweetest songs I'll raise;
And though I cannot see Him,
I know He hears my praise;
For He has kindly promised
That I shall surely go
To sing among His angels,
Because He loves me so!

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus loves! He who died
Heaven's gate to open wide:
He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus loves me! He will stay
Close beside me all the way:
If I love Him, when I die
He will take me home on high.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We stand for God, and for His glory
The Lord supreme and God of all;
Against His foes we raise His standard,
Around the cross we hear His call.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Strengthen our faith Redeemer,
Guard us when danger is nigh;
To you we pledge our lives and service
Strong in a trust that ne'er shall die.
To you we pledge our lives and service
Strong in a trust that ne'er shall die.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We stand for God, let us be loyal!
Our love proclaim with every breath,
To Christ our King and Lord of lords,
We shall be faithful unto death.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
What Child is this, who, laid to rest,
On Mary's lap is sleeping?
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
While shepherds watch are keeping?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing:
Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
The Babe, the Son of Mary!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Why lies He in such mean estate,
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christian, fear: for sinners here,
The silent Word is pleading.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
So bring Him incense, gold, and myrrh,
Come, peasant, king, to own Him!
The King of kings salvation brings,
Let loving hearts enthrone Him.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Who is on the Lord's side?
Who will serve the King?
Who will be His helpers,
Other lives to bring?
Who will leave the world's side?
Who will face the foe?
Who is on the Lord's side?
Who for Him will go?
By Thy call of mercy,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side,
Savior, we are Thine.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Not for weight of glory,
Not for crown and palm,
Enter we the army,
Rise against the calm;
But through love that offers
Life and peace and grace,
We will follow Jesus,
E'en at love's dear pace.
By Thy call of mercy,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side,
Savior, we are Thine.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, Thou hast bought us
Not with gold or gem,
But with Thine own life-blood,
For Thy diadem.
With Thy blessing filling
Each who comes to Thee,
Thou hast made us willing,
Thou hast made us free.
By Thy call of mercy,
By Thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side,
Savior, we are Thine.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I come to the garden alone,
While the dew is still on the roses;
And the voice I hear, falling on my ear,
The Son of God discloses.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
And He walks with me, and He talks with me,
And He tells me I am His own;
And the joy we share as we tarry there,
None other has ever known.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He speaks, and the sound of His voice
Is so sweet the birds hush their singing;
And the melody that He gave to me,
Within my heart is ringing.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'd stay in the garden with Him,
Though the night around me be falling;
But He bids me go; through the voice of woe,
His voice to me is calling.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is coming to earth again,
What if it were today?
Coming in power and love to reign,
What if it were today?
Coming to claim His chosen Bride,
All the redeemed and purified,
Over the whole earth scattered wide,
What if it were today?

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Satan's dominion will then be o'er,
What if it were today?
Sorrow and sighing shall be no more,
What if it were today?
Then shall the dead in Christ arise,
Caught up together to the skies,
So shall we ever with Him abide,
What if it were today?

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I have found a friend in Jesus, He's everything to me,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul;
The Lily of the Valley, in Him alone I see
All I need to cleanse and make me fully whole.
In sorrow He's my comfort, in trouble He's my stay,
He tells me every care on Him to roll.
He's the Lily of the Valley, the bright and Morning Star,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
He all my grief has taken, and all my sorrows borne;
In temptation He's my strong and mighty tow'r;
I have all for Him forsaken, and all my idols torn
From my heart, and now He keeps me by His pow'r.
Though all the world forsake me, and Satan tempt me sore,
Through Jesus I shall safely reach the goal.
He's the Lily of the Valley, the bright and Morning Star,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He will never, never leave me, nor yet forsake me here,
While I live by faith and do His blessed will;
A wall of fire about me, I've nothing now to fear,
With His manna He my hungry soul shall fill.
Then sweeping up to glory to see His blessed face,
Where rivers of delight shall ever roll.
He's the Lily of the Valley, the bright and Morning Star,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Day by day, and with each passing moment,
Strength I find to meet my trials here;
Trusting in my Father's wise bestowment,
I've no cause for worry or for fear.
He whose heart is kind beyond all measure,
Gives unto each day what He deems best,
Lovingly, its part of pain and pleasure,
Mingling toil with peace and rest.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Every day, the Lord Himself is near me,
With a special mercy for each hour;
All my cares He fain would bear, and cheer me,
He whose name is Counsellor and Pow'r.
The protection of His child and treasure,
Is a charge that on Himself He laid;
"As thy days, thy strength shall be in measure,"
This the pledge to me He made.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Help me then in every tribulation,
So to trust Thy promises, O Lord,
That I lose not faith's sweet consolation,
Offered me within Thy holy Word.
Help me, Lord, that when the storm is raging,
I may know Thy sheltering power and love,
And in peace, my soul, on wings of gladness,
Rise to dwell with Thee above.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Like a river glorious, is God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth, fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth, deeper all the way.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Stayed upon Jehovah, hearts are fully blest,
Finding, as He promised, perfect peace and rest.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touch the spirit there.

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Will your anchor hold in the storms of life,
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift, and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift, or firm remain?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
We have an anchor that keeps the soul,
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
It is safely moored, 'twill the storm withstand,
For 'tis well secured by the Savior's hand;
And the cables, passed from His heart to mine,
Can defy the blast, through strength divine.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
It will firmly hold in the straits of fear,
When the breakers have told the reef is near;
Though the tempest rave, it will stand the shock,
For in calm or wave, it is anchored to the Rock.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We've a story to tell to the nations,
That shall turn their hearts to the right,
A story of truth and mercy,
A story of peace and light,
A story of peace and light.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
For the darkness shall turn to dawning,
And the dawning to noonday bright,
And Christ's great kingdom shall come on earth,
The kingdom of love and light.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We've a song to be sung to the nations,
That shall lift their hearts to the Lord,
A song that shall conquer evil,
And shatter the spear and sword,
And shatter the spear and sword.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
We've a message to give to the nations,
That the Lord who reigneth above,
Has sent us His Son to save us,
And show us that God is love,
And show us that God is love.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a peace in my heart that the world never gave,
A peace it cannot take away;
Though the trials of life may surround like a cloud,
I've a peace that has come there to stay.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All the world seemed to sing of a Savior and King,
When peace sweetly came to my heart;
And the troubles of life could not banish the calm,
Nor the storms that may roll o'er my head.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Work, for the night is coming,
Work through the morning hours;
Work while the dew is sparkling,
Work 'mid springing flowers.
Work when the day grows brighter,
Work in the glowing sun;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man's work is done.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Work, for the night is coming,
Work through the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labor,
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute,
Something to keep in store;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Work, for the night is coming,
Under the sunset skies;
While their bright tints are glowing,
Work, for daylight flies.
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work, while the night is dark'ning,
When man's work is o'er.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
When Jesus comes to reward His servants,
Whether it be noon or night,
Faithful to Him will He find us watching,
With our lamps all trimmed and bright?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O can we say we are ready, brother?
Ready for the soul's bright home?
Say, will He find you and me still watching,
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
If, at the dawn of the early morning,
He shall call us one by one,
When to the Lord we restore our talents,
Will He answer thee—"Well done"?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Have we been true to the trust He left us?
Do we seek to do our best?
If in our hearts there is naught condemns us,
We shall have a glorious rest.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Who is He in yonder stall,
At whose feet the shepherds fall?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
'Tis the Lord! O wondrous story!
'Tis the Lord! the King of glory!
At His feet we humbly fall,
Crown Him, crown Him Lord of all.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Who is He in yonder cell,
Where the sons of bondage dwell?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Who is He on yonder tree,
Who dies in agony?

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Where He leads I'll follow,
Follow all the way;
Where He leads I'll follow,
Follow Jesus every day.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Sweet is the tender love,
Jesus has shown;
Sweeter far than any love that I've ever known.
So with my hand in His,
I'll walk the way,
Trusting Him to lead me safely home some day.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is joy in serving Jesus,
Joy that throbs within my heart;
Every moment, every hour,
As I draw upon His power,
There is joy in serving Jesus,
Joy that never shall depart.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
There is joy, joy,
Joy in serving Jesus,
Joy that throbs within my heart;
Every moment, every hour,
As I draw upon His power,
There is joy, joy,
Joy that never shall depart.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is joy in serving Jesus,
As I walk with Him each day;
There's a song of gladness ringing,
And my heart is ever singing,
There is joy in serving Jesus,
As I follow all the way.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a royal banner given for display
To the soldiers of the King;
As an ensign fair we lift it up today,
While as ransomed ones we sing.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Marching on, marching on,
For Christ count everything but loss;
And to crown Him King, we'll toil and sing,
'Neath the banner of the cross.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Though the foe may rage and gather as a flood,
Let the standard be displayed;
And beneath its folds, as soldiers of our God,
For the truth be not afraid.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Over land and sea, wherever man may dwell,
Make the glorious tidings known;
Of the crimson banner bid the story tell,
While the Lord shall claim His own.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!
None else could heal all our soul's diseases,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
No friend like Him is so high and holy,
No, not one! no, not one!
And yet no friend is so meek and lowly,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There's not an hour that He is not near us,
No, not one! no, not one!
No night so dark but His love can cheer us,
No, not one! no, not one!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's within my heart a melody,
Jesus whispers sweet and low,
"Fear not, I am with thee, peace, be still,"
In all of life's ebb and flow.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, Jesus, Jesus,
Sweetest name I know,
Fills my every longing,
Keeps me singing as I go.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All my life was wrecked by sin and strife,
Discord filled my heart with pain,
Jesus swept across the broken strings,
Stirred the slumbering chords again.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Feasting on the riches of His grace,
Resting 'neath His sheltering wing,
Always looking on His smiling face,
That is why I shout and sing.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Something happened to my life,
Something wonderful and new;
Jesus came into my heart,
And He made my life brand new.
I am living in a new world,
Walking in a new way,
Since I met the Man of Galilee,
Things are different now, I'm happy day by day.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Things are different now,
Something wonderful has happened,
Things are different now,
I am living in a new world,
Walking in a new way,
Since I met the Man of Galilee,
Things are different now, I'm happy day by day.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All my sins are washed away,
All my guilt is gone for good;
Jesus paid the penalty,
With His precious, sacred blood.
Now I have a joy that's lasting,
Peace that will not depart,
Since I met the Man of Galilee,
Things are different now, He lives within my heart.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Brightly beams our Father's mercy,
From His lighthouse evermore,
But to us He gives the keeping,
Of the lights along the shore.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Let the lower lights be burning!
Send a gleam across the wave!
Some poor fainting, struggling seaman,
You may rescue, you may save.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Dark the night of sin has settled,
Loud the angry billows roar;
Eager eyes are watching, longing,
For the lights along the shore.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Trim your feeble lamp, my brother!
Some poor sailor, tempest-tossed,
Trying now to make the harbor,
In the darkness may be lost.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Conquering now and still to conquer,
Rideth a King in His might,
Leading the host of all the faithful
Into the thickest of fight.
See, the banners of God unfurled,
See, the armies advance;
Onward in faith, to conquer the world,
This is our only chance.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Not to the strong is the battle,
Not to the swift is the race,
Yet to the true and the faithful,
Victory is promised through grace.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Conquering now and still to conquer,
Jesus, our Leader, Thou art;
Grant us Thy might and Thy Spirit,
Strength and courage impart.
Help us to fight and to conquer,
Help us to follow Thy way,
Then, through the darkness and danger,
Lead us to glory and day.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Simply trusting every day,
Trusting through a stormy way;
Even when my faith is small,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting Him whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
To the regions beyond I must go, I must go,
Where the story has never been told;
To the millions that never have heard of His love,
I must tell the story of old.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
To the regions beyond I must go, I must go,
Till the world has heard of His salvation,
Till the nations own Him as their King,
And the Lord returns to reign.
To the regions beyond I must go, I must go,
Till the world has heard the wondrous story,
Till the ends of earth have known His Name,
And the Lord returns to reign.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There are souls in the darkness of sin and despair,
Who have never yet heard of His grace;
They are waiting for someone to tell them the news,
Of the love that will brighten their face.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
There are lands that are waiting for laborers true,
Who will go and the gospel proclaim;
They are ready to hear the good news of the cross,
And to call on the Savior's dear name.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
'Tis the grandest theme through the ages rung,
'Tis the grandest theme for a mortal tongue;
'Tis the grandest theme that the world e'er knew,
Our God is able to deliver you.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
He is able to deliver thee,
He is able to deliver thee;
Though by sin oppressed, go to Him for rest,
Our God is able to deliver thee.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
'Tis the grandest theme in the earth or main,
'Tis the grandest theme for a mortal strain;
'Tis the grandest theme, tell the world anew,
Our God is able to deliver you.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
'Tis the grandest theme, let the tidings roll,
To the guilty heart, to the sinful soul;
Look to God in faith, He will bring you through,
Our God is able to deliver you.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Thy Word is like a garden, Lord,
With flowers bright and fair;
And everyone who seeks may pluck
A lovely cluster there.
Thy Word is like a deep, deep mine,
With jewels rich and rare;
And everyone who seeks may find
The priceless treasures there.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Thy Word is like a starry host,
A thousand rays of light,
To guide the wanderer in the night,
And make his pathway bright.
Thy Word is like a mighty sword,
That pierces through the heart,
And brings the sinner to the cross,
And heals the guilty smart.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thy Word is like a gentle stream,
That flows from God above,
And brings refreshing to the soul,
And peace and joy and love.
O may I love Thy precious Word,
And study it with care,
And hide its heavenly truths within,
That I may not despair.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Throw out the lifeline across the dark wave,
There is a brother whom someone should save;
Somebody's brother! O who then will dare
To throw out the lifeline, his peril to share?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Throw out the lifeline! Throw out the lifeline!
Someone is drifting away from the shore;
Throw out the lifeline! Throw out the lifeline!
Someone is sinking, O hasten today!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Throw out the lifeline with hand quick and strong,
Why do you tarry, why linger so long?
See! he is sinking, O hasten today,
And out with the lifeboat, away, then away!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Throw out the lifeline to danger-fraught men,
Sinking in anguish where you've never been;
Winds of temptation and billows of woe,
Will soon hurl them out where the dark waters flow.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Soon will the season of rescue be o'er,
Soon will they drift to eternity's shore;
Haste, then, my brother, no time for delay,
But throw out the lifeline and save them today.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and righteousness;
I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
But wholly lean on Jesus' name.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
On Christ, the solid Rock, I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand,
All other ground is sinking sand.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When darkness veils His lovely face,
I rest on His unchanging grace;
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
His oath, His covenant, and His blood,
Support me in the whelming flood;
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When He shall come with trumpet sound,
O may I then in Him be found,
Clothed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Savior's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain?
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
'Tis mystery all! The Immortal dies!
Who can explore His strange design?
In vain the firstborn seraph tries
To sound the depths of love divine.
'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore,
Let angel minds inquire no more.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He left His Father's throne above,
So free, so infinite His grace;
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race.
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For, O my God, it found out me!

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
No condemnation now I dread,
Jesus, and all in Him, is mine;
Alive in Him, my living Head,
And clothed in righteousness divine,
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Only a sinner, saved by grace,
Only a sinner, saved by grace;
This is my story, to God be the glory,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Only a sinner, saved by grace,
Only a sinner, saved by grace;
This is my story, to God be the glory,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.
Once I was lost in sin's dark night,
But Jesus came and gave me sight,
Now I am walking in the light,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Only a sinner, saved by grace,
Only a sinner, saved by grace;
This is my story, to God be the glory,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.
Now I can sing of redeeming love,
And praise my Savior who reigns above,
I have a home in heaven above,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Only a sinner, saved by grace,
Only a sinner, saved by grace;
This is my story, to God be the glory,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.
When I shall stand on the golden shore,
And see my Savior whom I adore,
I'll praise Him forever evermore,
Only a sinner, saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Fairest Lord Jesus, Ruler of all nature,
O Thou of God and man the Son,
Thee will I cherish, Thee will I honor,
Thou, my soul's glory, joy, and crown.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Fair are the meadows, fairer still the woodlands,
Robed in the blooming garb of spring;
Jesus is fairer, Jesus is purer,
Who makes the woeful heart to sing.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Fair is the sunshine, fairer still the moonlight,
And all the twinkling starry host;
Jesus shines brighter, Jesus shines purer,
Than all the angels heaven can boast.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Beautiful Savior, Lord of all the nations,
Son of God and Son of Man,
Glory and honor, praise, adoration,
Now and forevermore be Thine.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Work, for the night is coming,
Work through the morning hours;
Work while the dew is sparkling,
Work 'mid springing flowers.
Work when the day grows brighter,
Work in the glowing sun;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man's work is done.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Work, for the night is coming,
Work through the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labor,
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give every flying minute,
Something to keep in store;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Work, for the night is coming,
Under the sunset skies;
While their bright tints are glowing,
Work, for daylight flies.
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work, while the night is dark'ning,
When man's work is o'er.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O love of God, how rich and pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forevermore endure—
The saints' and angels' song.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When hoary time shall pass away,
And earthly thrones and kingdoms fall,
When men who here refuse to pray,
On rocks and hills and mountains call,
God's love so sure, shall still endure,
All measureless and strong;
Redeeming grace to Adam's race—
The saints' and angels' song.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Could we with ink the ocean fill,
And were the skies of parchment made,
Were every stalk on earth a quill,
And every man a scribe by trade,
To write the love of God above
Would drain the ocean dry;
Nor could the scroll contain the whole,
Though stretched from sky to sky.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
This is my Father's world,
And to my listening ears
All nature sings, and round me rings
The music of the spheres.
This is my Father's world,
I rest me in the thought
Of rocks and trees, of skies and seas—
His hand the wonders wrought.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
This is my Father's world,
The birds their carols raise,
The morning light, the lily white,
Declare their Maker's praise.
This is my Father's world,
He shines in all that's fair;
In the rustling grass I hear Him pass,
He speaks to me everywhere.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
This is my Father's world,
O let me ne'er forget
That though the wrong seems oft so strong,
God is the Ruler yet.
This is my Father's world,
The battle is not done;
Jesus who died shall be satisfied,
And earth and heaven be one.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The old Book and the old faith,
The old Book and the old faith,
They never can change, they are just the same,
The old Book and the old faith.
Though the world may doubt and scoff and scorn,
The old Book is true, though men are torn;
I'll stand on the Word of God,
The old Book and the old faith.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The old Book and the old faith,
The old Book and the old faith,
They never can change, they are just the same,
The old Book and the old faith.
It tells of a Savior who came to save,
Who conquered the grave and victory gave;
I'll trust in the Son of God,
The old Book and the old faith.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The old Book and the old faith,
The old Book and the old faith,
They never can change, they are just the same,
The old Book and the old faith.
When trials come and the way is dark,
Its promises still will be my ark;
I'll cling to the Word of God,
The old Book and the old faith.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The name of Jesus is so sweet,
I love its music to repeat;
It makes my joys complete,
The sweetest name I know.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, O how sweet the name!
Jesus, every day the same;
Jesus, let all saints proclaim
Its worthy praise forever.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I love the name of Jesus,
It brings such peace and rest;
It makes my soul to sing,
The sweetest name I know.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
That name I love so well,
The name that saved my soul;
The name that makes me whole,
The sweetest name I know.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The fight is on, the trumpet sound is ringing out,
The cry "To arms!" is heard afar and near;
The Lord of hosts is marching on to victory,
The triumph of the Christ will soon appear.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
The fight is on, O Christian soldier,
And face to face in stern array,
With armor gleaming, and colors streaming,
The right and wrong engage today!
The fight is on, but be not weary,
Be strong and in His might hold fast;
If God be for us, His banner o'er us,
We'll sing the victor's song at last.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The fight is on, arouse, ye soldiers brave and true!
Jehovah leads, and vict'ry will assure;
Go, buckle on the armor God has given you,
And in His strength unto the end endure.

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The first Noel the angel did say
Was to certain poor shepherds in fields as they lay;
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter's night that was so deep.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Born is the King of Israel.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east beyond them far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
And by the light of that same star
Three wise men came from country far;
To seek for a King was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
This star drew nigh to the northwest,
O'er Bethlehem it took its rest,
And there it did both stop and stay,
Right over the place where Jesus lay.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Then entered in those wise men three,
Fell reverently upon their knee,
And offered there in His presence
Their gold and myrrh and frankincense.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O now I see the cleansing wave!
The fountain deep and wide;
Jesus, my Lord, mighty to save,
Points to His wounded side.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
The cleansing stream I see, I see,
I plunge, and O, it cleanseth me!
O praise the Lord, it cleanseth me!
It cleanseth me, yes, cleanseth me!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I see the new creation rise,
I hear the speaking blood;
It speaks! polluted nature dies!
Sinks in the cleansing flood.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O come to this transforming tide,
And here your spirits lave;
'Tis Jesus, who for sinners died,
Can from the utmost save.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
The B-I-B-L-E,
Yes, that's the book for me;
I stand alone on the Word of God,
The B-I-B-L-E.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The B-I-B-L-E,
Yes, that's the book for me;
I read and believe the Word of God,
The B-I-B-L-E.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
The B-I-B-L-E,
Yes, that's the book for me;
I hide its truth in my heart,
The B-I-B-L-E.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Thanks to God for my Redeemer,
Thanks for all Thou dost provide!
Thanks for times now but a memory,
Thanks for Jesus by my side!
Thanks for pleasant, balmy springtime,
Thanks for dark and stormy fall!
Thanks for tears by now forgotten,
Thanks for peace within my soul!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Thanks to God for home and loved ones,
Thanks for friends so true and kind!
Thanks for all that makes life joyful,
Thanks for heart and soul and mind!
Thanks for trials and for temptations,
Thanks for sorrow and for pain!
Thanks for grace that keeps me humble,
Thanks that I may trust again!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thanks to God for hope and comfort,
Thanks for heaven and for home!
Thanks for pardon and salvation,
Thanks for strength to overcome!
Thanks for all that He has promised,
Thanks for all that is to come!
Thanks to God for His great mercy,
Praise His holy name alone!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Trying to walk in the steps of the Savior,
Trying to follow our Savior and King;
Shaping our lives by His blessed example,
Happy and blessed the joy that He brings.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
How beautiful to walk in the steps of the Savior,
Stepping in the light, stepping in the light;
How beautiful to walk in the steps of the Savior,
Led in paths of light.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Pressing more closely to Him who is leading,
When we are tempted to turn from the way;
Trusting His grace, and in confidence pleading,
He will not fail us nor leave us astray.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Walking in sunlight all of our journey,
Over the mountains, through valleys below;
Jesus, our Savior, will safely guide us,
Into the glory where rivers of joy flow.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Stand up, stand up, for Jesus,
Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner,
It must not suffer loss.
From victory unto victory
His army shall He lead,
Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Stand up, stand up, for Jesus,
The trumpet call obey;
Forth to the mighty conflict,
In this His glorious day.
Ye that are men now serve Him
Against unnumbered foes;
Let courage rise with danger,
And strength to strength oppose.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Stand up, stand up, for Jesus,
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you,
Ye dare not trust your own.
Put on the gospel armor,
Each piece put on with prayer;
Where duty calls or danger,
Be never wanting there.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Stand up, stand up, for Jesus,
The strife will not be long;
This day the noise of battle,
The next the victor's song.
To him that overcometh
A crown of life shall be;
He with the King of glory
Shall reign eternally.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I thirsted in the barren land of sin and shame,
And nothing satisfying there I found;
But to the blessed cross of Christ one day I came,
Where springs of living water did abound.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Drinking at the springs of living water,
Happy now am I, my soul they satisfy;
Drinking at the springs of living water,
O wonderful and bountiful supply.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
How sweet the living water from the hills of God,
It makes me glad and happy all the way;
Now glory, grace, and blessing mark the path I've trod,
I'm drinking from the fountain day by day.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O sinner, won't you come today and freely drink
Of this soul-cleansing, life-imparting wave?
Come to the cross of Christ, and on His merits think,
And find the living water that can save.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me;
See, on the portals He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Come home, come home,
Ye who are weary, come home;
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling,
Calling, O sinner, come home!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Why should we tarry when Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing,
Passing from you and from me;
Shadows are gathering, deathbeds are coming,
Coming for you and for me.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O for the wonderful love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me!
Though we have sinned, He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Singing I go along life's road,
Praising the Lord, praising the Lord;
Singing I go along life's road,
For Jesus has saved my soul.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Singing I go, singing I go,
Praising the Lord, praising the Lord;
Singing I go, singing I go,
For Jesus has saved my soul.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Trusting in Him who died for me,
Praising the Lord, praising the Lord;
Trusting in Him who died for me,
For Jesus has set me free.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Gladly I'll serve my King divine,
Praising the Lord, praising the Lord;
Gladly I'll serve my King divine,
And tell of His love to all.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I have a song I love to sing,
Since I have been redeemed;
Of my Redeemer, Savior, King,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I have a Christ who satisfies,
Since I have been redeemed;
To do His will my highest prize,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I have a witness bright and clear,
Since I have been redeemed;
Dispelling every doubt and fear,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
I have a home prepared for me,
Since I have been redeemed;
Where I shall dwell eternally,
Since I have been redeemed.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's a call comes ringing o'er the restless wave,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
There are souls to rescue, there are souls to save,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We have heard the Macedonian call today,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
And a golden offering at the cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Let us pray that grace may everywhere abound,
Send the light! Send the light!
And a Christlike spirit everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Let us not grow weary in the work of love,
Send the light! Send the light!
Let us gather jewels for a crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Savior, like a shepherd lead us,
Much we need Thy tender care;
In Thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Thy folds prepare.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, we are Thine;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, we are Thine.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We are Thine, do Thou befriend us,
Be the guardian of our way;
Keep Thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Hear, O hear us when we pray;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Hear, O hear us when we pray.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse, and power to free.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
We will early turn to Thee;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
We will early turn to Thee.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Early let us seek Thy favor,
Early let us do Thy will;
Blessed Lord and only Savior,
With Thy love our spirits fill.
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Thou hast loved us, love us still;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Thou hast loved us, love us still.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Silent night, holy night,
All is calm, all is bright;
Round yon virgin mother and Child,
Holy Infant so tender and mild,
Sleep in heavenly peace,
Sleep in heavenly peace.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Silent night, holy night,
Shepherds quake at the sight;
Glories stream from heaven afar,
Heavenly hosts sing Alleluia!
Christ the Savior is born,
Christ the Savior is born!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Silent night, holy night,
Son of God, love's pure light;
Radiant beams from Thy holy face,
With the dawn of redeeming grace,
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth,
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We praise Thee, O God,
For the Son of Thy love,
For Jesus who died,
And is now gone above.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Hallelujah! Thine the glory,
Hallelujah! Amen!
Hallelujah! Thine the glory,
Revive us again.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
We praise Thee, O God,
For Thy Spirit of light,
Who has shown us our Savior,
And scattered our night.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All glory and praise
To the Lamb that was slain,
Who has borne all our sins,
And has cleansed every stain.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Revive us again,
Fill each heart with Thy love;
May each soul be rekindled
With fire from above.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.
Christ, the royal Master,
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle,
See His banners go!

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Onward, Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
At the sign of triumph
Satan's host doth flee;
On, then, Christian soldiers,
On to victory!
Hell's foundations quiver
At the shout of praise;
Brothers, lift your voices,
Loud your anthems raise.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Like a mighty army
Moves the church of God;
Brothers, we are treading
Where the saints have trod.
We are not divided,
All one body we,
One in hope and doctrine,
One in charity.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Crowns and thrones may perish,
Kingdoms rise and wane,
But the church of Jesus
Constant will remain.
Gates of hell can never
'Gainst that church prevail;
We have Christ's own promise,
And that cannot fail.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Onward, then, ye people,
Join our happy throng,
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph song.
Glory, laud, and honor
Unto Christ the King,
This through countless ages
Men and angels sing.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Only a sinner saved by grace,
Only a sinner saved by grace;
This is my story, to God be the glory,
Only a sinner saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Once I was lost in sin's dark night,
But Jesus came and gave me sight,
Now I am walking in the light,
Only a sinner saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Now I can sing of redeeming love,
And praise my Savior who reigns above,
I have a home in heaven above,
Only a sinner saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When I shall stand on the golden shore,
And see my Savior whom I adore,
I'll praise Him forever evermore,
Only a sinner saved by grace.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
O to be like Thee! blessed Redeemer,
This is my constant longing and prayer;
Gladly I'll forfeit all of earth's treasures,
Jesus, Thy perfect likeness to wear.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
O to be like Thee! full of compassion,
Loving, forgiving, tender and kind,
Helping the helpless, cheering the fainting,
Seeking the wandering sinner to find.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O to be like Thee! lowly in spirit,
Holy and harmless, patient and brave;
Meekly enduring cruel reproaches,
Willing to suffer, others to save.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O to be like Thee! while I am pleading,
Pour out Thy Spirit, fill with Thy love;
Make me a temple meet for Thy dwelling,
Fit me for life and service above.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
Naught of this world's delusive dream;
I have renounced all sinful pleasure,
Jesus is mine, there's nothing between.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor,
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Nothing between, like worldly pleasure,
Habits of life, though harmless they seem;
Must not my heart from Him ever sever,
He is my all, there's nothing between.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Nothing between, like pride or station,
Self or friends shall not intervene;
Though it may cost me much tribulation,
I am resolved, there's nothing between.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I was sinking deep in sin,
Far from the peaceful shore,
Very deeply stained within,
Sinking to rise no more;
But the Master of the sea
Heard my despairing cry,
From the waters lifted me,
Now safe am I.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help,
Love lifted me!
Love lifted me! Love lifted me!
When nothing else could help,
Love lifted me!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All my heart to Him I give,
Ever to Him I'll cling,
In His blessed presence live,
Ever His praises sing.
Love so mighty and so true
Merits my soul's best songs;
Faithful, loving service, too,
To Him belongs.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Like a river glorious, is God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth, fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth, deeper all the way.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Stayed upon Jehovah, hearts are fully blest,
Finding, as He promised, perfect peace and rest.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touch the spirit there.

sections.title: Verse 3
Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
We have heard the joyful sound,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Spread the tidings all around,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Bear the news to every land,
Climb the mountains, cross the waves,
Onward, 'tis the Lord's command,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Waft it on the rolling tide,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Tell to sinners far and wide,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Sing, ye islands of the sea,
Echo back, ye ocean caves,
Earth shall keep her jubilee,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Give the winds a mighty voice,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Let the nations now rejoice,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Shout salvation full and free,
Highest hills and deepest caves,
This our song of victory,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I hear the Savior say,
'Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all.'

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Lord, now indeed I find,
Thy power and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots,
And melt the heart of stone.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
For nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim;
I'll wash my garments white
In the blood of Calvary's Lamb.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
And when, before the throne,
I stand in Him complete,
'Jesus died my soul to save,'
My lips shall still repeat.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus loves me! This I know,
For the Bible tells me so;
Little ones to Him belong,
They are weak, but He is strong.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus loves me! He who died,
Heaven's gate to open wide;
He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus loves me! Loves me still,
Though I'm very weak and ill;
From His shining throne on high,
Comes to watch me where I lie.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
A Friend I have, called Jesus,
Whose love is strong and true,
And never fails howe'er 'tis tried,
No matter what I do.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
It's just like His great love,
It's just like His great love,
It's just like His great love to care for me;
It's just like His great love,
It's just like His great love,
It's just like His great love to care for me.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I've sinned against this love,
But it has pardoned me,
And now I live in peace and joy,
From sin and sorrow free.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I have a song that Jesus gave me,
It was sent from heaven above;
There never was a sweeter melody,
'Tis a melody of love.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
In my heart there rings a melody,
There rings a melody with heaven's harmony;
In my heart there rings a melody,
There rings a melody of love.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I love the Christ who died on Calvary,
For He washed my sins away;
He put within my heart a melody,
And I know He's there to stay.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'll sing for Him who gave me victory,
And His love I will proclaim;
The melody that rings within my soul,
Is a song in Jesus' name.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I know that Jesus saves me,
And He keeps me day by day;
I know His blood has cleansed me,
And has washed my sins away.
I know He'll never leave me,
Though the storms of life may blow,
And isn't the love of Jesus something wonderful?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Wonderful, wonderful,
Isn't the love of Jesus something wonderful?
Wonderful, wonderful,
Isn't the love of Jesus something wonderful?
He left His Father's throne above,
To show to me His wonderful love,
O isn't the love of Jesus something wonderful?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
When I was lost in darkness,
He came down to set me free;
He broke the chains of bondage,
And He gave me victory.
Now I am walking with Him,
And His love I daily know,
And isn't the love of Jesus something wonderful?

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
You have longed for sweet peace,
And for faith to increase,
And have earnestly, fervently prayed;
But you cannot have rest,
Or be perfectly blest,
Until all on the altar is laid.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Is your all on the altar of sacrifice laid?
Your heart, does the Spirit control?
You can only be blest and have peace and sweet rest,
As you yield Him your body and soul.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Would you walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
And have peace and contentment alway?
You must do His sweet will,
To be free from all ill,
On the altar your all you must lay.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O we never can know
What the Lord will bestow
Of the blessings for which we have prayed,
Till our body and soul
He doth fully control,
And our all on the altar is laid.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
I've found a Friend, oh, such a Friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love,
And thus He bound me to Him.
And round my heart still closely twine
Those ties which naught can sever,
For I am His, and He is mine,
Forever and forever.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
I've found a Friend, oh, such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But His own self He gave me.
Naught that I have my own I call,
I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life, my all,
Are His, and His forever.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I've found a Friend, oh, such a Friend!
All power to Him is given,
To guard me on my onward course,
And bring me safe to heaven.
The eternal glories gleam afar,
To nerve my faint endeavor;
So now to watch, to work, to war,
And then to rest forever.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord,
Is laid for your faith in His excellent Word!
What more can He say than to you He hath said,
To you who for refuge to Jesus have fled?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Fear not, I am with thee, O be not dismayed,
For I am thy God, and will still give thee aid;
I'll strengthen thee, help thee, and cause thee to stand,
Upheld by My righteous, omnipotent hand.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
When through the deep waters I call thee to go,
The rivers of sorrow shall not overflow;
For I will be with thee, thy troubles to bless,
And sanctify to thee thy deepest distress.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When through fiery trials thy pathway shall lie,
My grace, all-sufficient, shall be thy supply;
The flame shall not hurt thee; I only design
Thy dross to consume, and thy gold to refine.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
The soul that on Jesus hath leaned for repose,
I will not, I will not desert to his foes;
That soul, though all hell should endeavor to shake,
I'll never, no never, no never forsake!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Would you live for Jesus, and be always pure and good?
Would you walk with Him within the narrow way?
Would you have Him bear your burden, carry all your load?
Let Him have His way with thee.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Would you have Him make you fruitful in His service here?
Would you have Him teach you how to watch and pray?
Would you have Him give you strength for every task and fear?
Let Him have His way with thee.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Would you have Him purify your heart and make it whole?
Would you have Him lead you safely to the end?
Would you have Him take you home to be with Him above?
Let Him have His way with thee.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There is pardon for sin,
And a peace that abides,
And a joy that is given to all;
And a love that is shed
From the Father above,
Through the blood of the Lamb on the fall.

sections.title: Chorus
Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
There is peace in my soul,
For my sins are forgiven,
And my sins are remembered no more;
And I know I am saved,
For the Spirit has witness,
And I know I am safe on that shore.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Man of Sorrows! what a name
For the Son of God, who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim!
Hallelujah! what a Savior!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned He stood,
Sealed my pardon with His blood;
Hallelujah! what a Savior!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Guilty, vile, and helpless we,
Spotless Lamb of God was He;
Full atonement! can it be?
Hallelujah! what a Savior!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Lifted up was He to die,
'It is finished!' was His cry;
Now in heaven exalted high,
Hallelujah! what a Savior!

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew this song we'll sing,
Hallelujah! what a Savior!

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Hark! the herald angels sing,
'Glory to the newborn King;
Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled!'
Joyful, all ye nations, rise,
Join the triumph of the skies;
With the angelic host proclaim,
'Christ is born in Bethlehem!'

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Hark! the herald angels sing,
'Glory to the newborn King!'

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Christ, by highest heaven adored,
Christ, the everlasting Lord,
Late in time behold Him come,
Offspring of the virgin's womb.
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see,
Hail the incarnate Deity!
Pleased as man with men to dwell,
Jesus, our Emmanuel.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Hail the heaven-born Prince of Peace!
Hail the Sun of Righteousness!
Light and life to all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord,
A wonderful Savior to me;
He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
Where rivers of pleasure I see.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
He hideth my soul in the cleft of the rock,
That shadows a dry, thirsty land;
He hideth my life in the depths of His love,
And covers me there with His hand,
And covers me there with His hand.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
A wonderful Savior is Jesus my Lord,
He taketh my burden away;
He holdeth me up, and I shall not be moved,
He giveth me strength as my day.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
With numberless blessings each moment He crowns,
And filled with His fullness divine,
I sing in my rapture, O glory to God,
For such a Redeemer as mine!

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When clothed in His brightness, transported I rise,
To meet Him in clouds of the sky,
His perfect salvation, His wonderful love,
I'll shout with the millions on high.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
There's within my heart a melody,
Jesus whispers sweet and low,
'Fear not, I am with thee, peace, be still,'
In all of life's ebb and flow.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Jesus, Jesus, Jesus,
Sweetest name I know,
Fills my every longing,
Keeps me singing as I go.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
All my life was wrecked by sin and strife,
Discord filled my heart with pain,
Jesus swept across the broken strings,
Stirred the slumbering chords again.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Feasting on the riches of His grace,
Resting 'neath His sheltering wing,
Always looking on His smiling face,
That is why I shout and sing.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Come, Thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy, never ceasing,
Call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me some melodious sonnet,
Sung by flaming tongues above;
Praise the mount! I'm fixed upon it,
Mount of Thy redeeming love.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Here I raise my Ebenezer,
Hither by Thy help I'm come;
And I hope, by Thy good pleasure,
Safely to arrive at home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger,
Wandering from the fold of God;
He, to rescue me from danger,
Interposed His precious blood.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be!
Let Thy goodness, like a fetter,
Bind my wandering heart to Thee.
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it,
Prone to leave the God I love;
Here's my heart, O take and seal it,
Seal it for Thy courts above.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
It may be at morn, when the day is awaking,
When sunlight through darkness and shadow is breaking,
That Jesus will come in the fullness of glory,
To receive from the world His own.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
O Lord Jesus, how long, how long
Ere we shout the glad song,
Christ returneth! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Amen. Hallelujah! Amen.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
It may be at midday, it may be at twilight,
It may be, perchance, that the blackness of midnight
Will burst into light in the blaze of His glory,
When Jesus receives His own.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
While hosts cry Hosanna, from heaven descending,
With glorified saints and the angels attending,
With grace on His brow, like a halo of glory,
He will receive His own.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O joy! O delight! should we go without dying,
No sickness, no sadness, no dread, and no crying,
Caught up through the clouds with our Lord into glory,
When Jesus receives His own.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
How I praise Thee, precious Savior,
