That Thy love laid hold of me;
Thou hast saved and cleansed and filled me,
That I might Thy channel be.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Channels only, blessed Master,
But with all Thy wondrous power
Flowing through us, Thou canst use us
Every day and every hour.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Just a channel, full of blessing,
To the thirsty hearts around;
To tell out Thy full salvation,
All Thy loving message sound.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Emptied that Thou shouldest fill me,
A clean vessel in Thy hand;
With no power but as Thou givest
Graciously with each command.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Witnessing Thy power to save me,
Setting free from self and sin;
Thou who purchased my redemption,
Condescend to use me then.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Brethren, we have met to worship
And adore the Lord our God;
Will you pray with all your power,
While we try to preach the Word?
All is vain unless the Spirit
Of the Holy One comes down;
Brethren, pray, and holy manna
Will be showered all around.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Brethren, see poor sinners round you
Slumbering on the brink of woe;
Death is coming, hell is moving,
Can you bear to let them go?
See our fathers and our mothers,
And our children sinking down;
Brethren, pray, and holy manna
Will be showered all around.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Let us love our God supremely,
Let us love each other too;
Let us love and pray for sinners,
Till our God makes all things new.
Then He'll call us home to heaven,
At His table we'll sit down;
Christ will gird Himself and serve us
With sweet manna all around.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in Christian love;
The fellowship of kindred minds
Is like to that above.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Before our Father's throne
We pour our ardent prayers;
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one,
Our comforts and our cares.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
We share our mutual woes,
Our mutual burdens bear;
And often for each other flows
The sympathizing tear.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
When we asunder part,
It gives us inward pain;
But we shall still be joined in heart,
And hope to meet again.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
This glorious hope revives
Our courage by the way;
While each in expectation lives,
And longs to see the day.

sections.title: Verse 6
sections.lyrics:
From sorrow, toil, and pain,
And sin, we shall be free,
And perfect love and friendship reign
Through all eternity.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Blessed Redeemer, how precious Thou art to me,
Jesus my Savior, my Lord and my King;
Thou art my refuge, my strength and my hiding place,
Sweetest of all songs my heart can sing.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Blessed Redeemer, dear Savior to me,
Precious Redeemer, my all in all Thou art;
Blessed Redeemer, I'll ever adore Thee,
The Lamb of Calvary, the King of my heart.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Blessed Redeemer, Thy love is so wonderful,
Sweeter than honey, more precious than gold;
Thou art my comfort, my hope and my victory,
Thou art the one who keeps my soul.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Blessed Redeemer, I long for Thy coming again,
Soon Thou wilt call me to heaven above;
There I shall see Thee and evermore be with Thee,
There I shall dwell in Thy wonderful love.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Joys are flowing like a river,
Since the Comforter has come;
He abides with us forever,
Makes the trusting heart His home.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Blessed quietness, holy quietness,
What assurance in my soul!
On the stormy sea, He speaks peace to me,
How the billows cease to roll!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Bringing life and peace and gladness,
All our sinfulness He heals;
Filling us with joy and fullness,
All His holiness He reveals.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Like the rain that falls from heaven,
Like the sunlight from above,
So the Holy Ghost is given,
Filling us with perfect love.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Beneath the cross of Jesus
I fain would take my stand,
The shadow of a mighty rock
Within a weary land;
A home within the wilderness,
A rest upon the way,
From the burning of the noontide heat,
And the burden of the day.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Upon that cross of Jesus
Mine eye at times can see
The very dying form of One
Who suffered there for me;
And from my stricken heart with tears
Two wonders I confess,
The wonders of redeeming love,
And my own worthlessness.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I take, O cross, thy shadow
For my abiding place;
I ask no other sunshine than
The sunshine of His face;
Content to let the world go by,
To know no gain nor loss,
My sinful self my only shame,
My glory all the cross.

sections.title: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Be still, my soul, the hour is hastening on
When we shall be forever with the Lord,
When disappointment, grief, and fear are gone,
Sorrow forgot, love's purest joys restored.
Be still, my soul, when change and tears are past,
All safe and blessed we shall meet at last.

sections.title: Verse 1
Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Glory, glory, hallelujah!
Glory, glory, hallelujah!
Glory, glory, hallelujah!
His truth is marching on.

sections.title: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born across the sea,
With a glory in His bosom that transfigures you and me;
As He died to make men holy, let us die to make men free,
While God is marching on.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
The little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head;
The stars in the sky looked down where He lay,
The little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The cattle are lowing, the Baby awakes,
But little Lord Jesus, no crying He makes;
I love Thee, Lord Jesus, look down from the sky,
And stay by my cradle till morning is nigh.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Be near me, Lord Jesus, I ask Thee to stay,
Close by me forever, and love me, I pray;
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care,
And fit us for heaven, to live with Thee there.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Years I spent in vanity and pride,
Caring not my Lord was crucified,
Knowing not it was for me He died
On Calvary.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Mercy there was great, and grace was free,
Pardon there was multiplied to me;
There my burdened soul found liberty,
At Calvary.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
By God's Word at last my sin I learned,
Then I trembled at the law I'd spurned,
Till my guilty soul imploring turned
To Calvary.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Now I've given to Jesus everything,
Now I gladly own Him as my King,
Now my raptured soul can only sing
Of Calvary.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
O the love that drew salvation's plan,
O the grace that brought it down to man,
O the mighty gulf that God did span
At Calvary.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Savior's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain?
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
'Tis mystery all! The Immortal dies!
Who can explore His strange design?
In vain the firstborn seraph tries
To sound the depths of love divine.
'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore,
Let angel minds inquire no more.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
He left His Father's throne above,
So free, so infinite His grace;
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race.
'Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For, O my God, it found out me!

sections.title: Verse 4
Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
No condemnation now I dread,
Jesus, and all in Him, is mine;
Alive in Him, my living Head,
And clothed in righteousness divine,
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation's story,
Now proclaim Messiah's birth.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ, the newborn King.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Shepherds, in the field abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant light.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Sages, leave your contemplations,
Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great Desire of nations,
Ye have seen His natal star.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Saints, before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In His temple shall appear.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
My Father is rich in houses and lands,
He holdeth the wealth of the world in His hands!
Of rubies and diamonds, of silver and gold,
His coffers are full, He has riches untold.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
I'm a child of the King,
A child of the King!
With Jesus my Savior,
I'm a child of the King.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
My Father's own Son, the Savior of men,
Once wandered on earth as the poorest of them;
But now He is reigning forever on high,
And will give me a home in His palace on high.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I once was an outcast stranger on earth,
A sinner by choice, and an alien by birth;
But I've been adopted, my name's written down,
An heir to a mansion, a robe, and a crown.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
A tent or a cottage, why should I care?
They're building a palace for me over there;
Though exiled from home, yet still I may sing,
All glory to God, I'm a child of the King.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Give me a passion for souls, dear Lord,
A passion to save the lost;
O give me a passion for souls, dear Lord,
Whatever it may cost.

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
A passion for souls, a passion for souls,
Dear Lord, give me a passion for souls;
O burden my heart with the lost to impart,
And give me a passion for souls.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Give me a passion for souls, dear Lord,
For those who are far from Thee;
O give me a passion for souls, dear Lord,
To bring them to Calvary.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Give me a passion for souls, dear Lord,
To labor and watch and pray;
O give me a passion for souls, dear Lord,
Till dawns that glorious day.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Alas! and did my Savior bleed,
And did my Sovereign die?
Would He devote that sacred head
For such a worm as I?

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
At the cross, at the cross where I first saw the light,
And the burden of my heart rolled away,
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I am happy all the day!

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Was it for crimes that I had done,
He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! grace unknown!
And love beyond degree!

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Well might the sun in darkness hide,
And shut its glories in,
When Christ, the mighty Maker, died
For man the creature's sin.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Thus might I hide my blushing face,
While His dear cross appears,
Dissolve my heart in thankfulness,
And melt my eyes to tears.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
All for Jesus! all for Jesus!
All my being's ransomed powers:
All my thoughts and words and doings,
All my days and all my hours.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Let my hands perform His bidding,
Let my feet run in His ways;
Let my eyes see Jesus only,
Let my lips speak forth His praise.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
All for Jesus! all for Jesus!
All my days and all my hours;
All for Jesus! all for Jesus!
All my being's ransomed powers.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Since my eyes were fixed on Jesus,
I've lost sight of all beside;
So enchained my spirit's vision,
Looking at the Crucified.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
O what wonder! how amazing!
Jesus, glorious King of kings,
Deigns to call me His beloved,
Lets me rest beneath His wings.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is all I need,
Jesus is all I need;
He fills my soul, He makes me whole,
Jesus is all I need.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is all I need,
In Him I am complete;
He gives me peace and sweet release,
Jesus is all I need.

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is all I need,
His love is full and free;
He satisfies, my soul supplies,
Jesus is all I need.

sections.title: Verse 4
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is all I need,
Through all the storms of life;
He holds my hand, He helps me stand,
Jesus is all I need.

sections.title: Verse 5
sections.lyrics:
Jesus is all I need,
When I shall see His face;
I'll sing His praise through endless days,
Jesus is all I need.

sections.title: Verse 1
sections.lyrics:
A voice from the Savior, a call to the brave,
A word that is sounding beyond the dark wave;
'Who'll go for the Master, who'll go in His name,
And carry the gospel to sinners in shame?'

sections.title: Chorus
sections.lyrics:
As a volunteer, as a volunteer,
I'll go for the Master, I'll go, I'll go;
As a volunteer, as a volunteer,
I'll carry the gospel wherever I go.

sections.title: Verse 2
sections.lyrics:
The Master is calling, He calls thee today,
O will you not answer, O will you not say,
'I'll go, blessed Savior, I'll go in Thy name,
And carry the gospel to sinners in shame'?

sections.title: Verse 3
sections.lyrics:
I'll go where the battle is fiercest today,
I'll go where the Master shall lead me alway;
I'll work in His vineyard, His cause I'll defend,
And follow the Lord to the very end.
